title.zh: 卷五 本紀第五: 高宗下
title.raw: 卷五 本紀第五: 高宗下 Volume 5 Annals 5: Gaozong 2

sentences.zh: 乾封元年麟德三年春正月戊辰朔，車駕至泰山頓。

translations.literal: In the third year of Linde, spring, first month, on wuchen, the new moon, the imperial carriage halted at Mount Tai.
translations.idiomatic: In Linde 3, on the wuchen new moon of the first spring month, the emperor halted at Mount Tai.

sentences.zh: 是日親祀昊天上帝於封祀壇，以高祖、太宗配饗。

translations.literal: That day he personally sacrificed to the Supreme Lord of the Vast Heaven at the feng altar, with Gaozu and Taizong joining in the offering.
translations.idiomatic: That day he sacrificed in person to the Lord on High at the feng altar, with Gaozu and Taizong as associates in the rite.

sentences.zh: 己巳，帝升山行封禪之禮。

translations.literal: On jisi the emperor ascended the mountain to perform the feng and shan rites.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi the emperor climbed the mountain for the fengshan ceremony.

sentences.zh: 庚午，禪於社首，祭皇地祇，以太穆太皇太后、文德皇太后配饗；

translations.literal: On gengwu he performed the shan at Sheshou, sacrificing to Imperial Earth, with the Grand Imperial Dowager Tai Mu and the Grand Imperial Dowager Wende joining in the offering;
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu he performed the shan rite at Sheshou, sacrificing to Earth, with Empresses Tai Mu and Wende as associates;

sentences.zh: 皇后為亞獻，越國太妃燕氏為終獻。

translations.literal: the empress served as secondary offerer, and Grand Consort Yan of Yue as final offerer.
translations.idiomatic: the empress made the secondary offering and Grand Consort Yan of Yue the final offering.

sentences.zh: 辛未，御降禪壇。

translations.literal: On xinwei he proceeded to the descent-from-shan altar.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei he descended to the shan altar.

sentences.zh: 壬申，御朝覲壇受朝賀。

translations.literal: On renshen he proceeded to the Court-Audience Altar to receive congratulations.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen he took his place at the Court-Audience Altar to receive homage.

sentences.zh: 改麟德三年為乾封元年，諸行從文武官及朝覲華戎岳牧、致仕老人朝朔望者，三品已上賜爵二等，四品已下、七品以上加階，八品已下加一階，勛一轉。

translations.literal: Linde 3 was changed to Qianfeng 1; all civil and military officials in the procession and all Chinese and barbarian frontier lords and retired elders attending the new- and full-moon audiences—those of third rank and above were granted two grades of nobility; those of fourth rank and below of seventh rank and above received rank increments; those of eighth rank and below received one increment; merit registers advanced one turn.
translations.idiomatic: The era was renamed Qianfeng 1; every official in the cortège and every lord and retired elder gathered for homage—those of third rank or higher received two degrees of nobility; fourth through seventh received rank increases; eighth rank and below gained one step; all merit rolls advanced one turn.

sentences.zh: 諸老人百歲已上版授下州刺史，婦人郡君；

translations.literal: All elders one hundred years and above were granted by patent the nominal rank of prefect of a lower prefecture, and women that of district lady;
translations.idiomatic: Elders aged one hundred or more were patent-appointed nominal prefects of lower prefectures, and women district ladies;

sentences.zh: 九十、八十節級。

translations.literal: those of ninety and eighty received graded ranks by tier.
translations.idiomatic: ninety- and eighty-year-olds received tiered honors.

sentences.zh: 齊州給復一年半，管岳縣二年。

translations.literal: Qizhou was granted tax remission for a year and a half, and the counties governing the sacred peaks for two years.
translations.idiomatic: Qizhou was exempted from levies for eighteen months and the counties under the sacred peaks for two years.

sentences.zh: 所歷之處，無出今年租賦。

translations.literal: Every place traversed was excused from paying this year's land tax and levies.
translations.idiomatic: Every region on the route was relieved of this year's taxes and corvée.

sentences.zh: 乾封元年正月五日已前，大赦天下，賜酺七日。

translations.literal: Before the fifth day of the first month of Qianfeng 1, a general amnesty was granted throughout the realm and feasting for seven days.
translations.idiomatic: Through the fifth day of Qianfeng 1's first month the court proclaimed a general amnesty and seven days of public feasting.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，宴群臣，陳《九部樂》，賜物有差，日昳而罷。

translations.literal: On guiyou he feasted the assembled ministers, staged the Nine Departments of Music, and bestowed gifts in varying measure; the banquet ended at the sun's declination.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou he banqueted the ministers, presented the Nine Sets of Music, and gave graded gifts; the feast ended at midday.

sentences.zh: 丙子，皇太子弘設會。

translations.literal: On bingzi Crown Prince Hong held a feast.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi Crown Prince Hong hosted a feast.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，以前恩薄，普進爵及階勛等。

translations.literal: On dingchou, because the earlier grace had been slight, ranks of nobility, rank increments, and merit registers were universally advanced.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou, judging the prior rewards too modest, the court advanced noble ranks, steps, and merit rolls for all.

sentences.zh: 男子賜古爵。

translations.literal: Men were granted ancient-style noble titles.
translations.idiomatic: Every man received an antique-style noble title.

sentences.zh: 兗州界置紫雲。

translations.literal: Within Yanzhou's jurisdiction were established the Purple Cloud
translations.idiomatic: In Yanzhou territory were founded the Purple Cloud

sentences.zh: 仙鶴、萬歲觀，封巒、非煙、重輪三寺。

translations.literal: Immortal Crane, and Longevity observatories, and Feng Luan, Feiyan, and Chonglun monasteries.
translations.idiomatic: Immortal Crane, and Longevity observatories, and the Feng Luan, Feiyan, and Chonglun monasteries.

sentences.zh: 天下諸州署觀、寺一所。

translations.literal: Every prefecture in the realm was to have one Daoist observatory and one Buddhist monastery established.
translations.idiomatic: Each prefecture in the empire was ordered to establish one Daoist abbey and one Buddhist monastery.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，發自泰山。

translations.literal: On bingxu he departed from Mount Tai.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu he left Mount Tai.

sentences.zh: 甲午，次曲阜縣，幸孔子廟。

translations.literal: On jiawu he halted at Qufu County and visited the temple of Confucius.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu he stopped at Qufu and visited Confucius's temple.

sentences.zh: 追贈太師，增修祠宇，以少牢致祭。

translations.literal: He was posthumously enfeoffed as Grand Tutor, the shrine buildings were enlarged, and sacrifice was offered with the lesser livestock.
translations.idiomatic: Confucius was posthumously named Grand Tutor, the shrine was enlarged, and the court offered the lesser tai sacrifice.

sentences.zh: 其褒聖侯德倫子孫，並免賦役。

translations.literal: The descendants of Marquis Baosheng Delun were all excused from tax and corvée.
translations.idiomatic: All descendants of Marquis Baosheng Delun were exempted from taxes and labor service.

sentences.zh: 二月己未，次亳州。

translations.literal: In the second month, on jiwei, he halted at Bozhou.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei of the second month he stopped at Bozhou.

sentences.zh: 幸老君廟，追號曰太上玄元皇帝，創造祠堂。

translations.literal: He visited the temple of Lord Lao, posthumously styled him Supreme Mysterious Primordial Emperor, and built a memorial hall.
translations.idiomatic: He visited Lord Lao's temple, posthumously styled him Supreme Mysterious Primordial Emperor, and erected a memorial hall.

sentences.zh: 其廟置令、丞各一員。

translations.literal: That temple was given one magistrate and one assistant apiece.
translations.idiomatic: The temple received one magistrate and one assistant each.

sentences.zh: 改穀陽縣為真源縣，縣內宗姓特給復一年。

translations.literal: Guyang County was renamed Zhenyuan County, and households of the imperial surname within the county received a special tax remission of one year.
translations.idiomatic: Guyang was renamed Zhenyuan, and clansmen in the county received an extra year of tax exemption.

sentences.zh: 夏四月甲辰，車駕至自泰山，先謁太廟而後入。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of summer, on jiachen, the imperial carriage returned from Mount Tai; he first visited the Imperial Ancestral Temple, then entered the palace.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen of the fourth summer month the emperor returned from Mount Tai, visited the Imperial Ancestral Temple, and only then entered the palace.

sentences.zh: 五月庚寅，改鑄乾封泉寶錢。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on gengyin, Qianfeng Treasure cash was newly cast.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin of the fifth month the court minted Qianfeng Treasure coins.

sentences.zh: 六月壬寅，高麗莫離支蓋蘇文死。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on renyin, Goguryeo's Mo-li-zhī Gaisuwen died.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin of the sixth month Gaisuwen, Mo-li-zhī of Goguryeo, died.

sentences.zh: 其子男生繼其父位，為其弟男建所逐，使其子獻誠詣闕請降，詔左驍衛大將軍契苾何力率兵以應接之。

translations.literal: His son Namsaeng succeeded to his father's position, was driven out by his brother Namgeon, and sent his son Heumseong to the court to request surrender; an edict ordered Qibi Heli, General-in-Chief of the Left Martial Tigers Guard, to lead troops to receive him.
translations.idiomatic: His son Namsaeng took his place but was expelled by his brother Namgeon; Namsaeng sent his son Heumseong to court to surrender, and the emperor ordered Qibi Heli, general-in-chief of the Left Martial Tigers Guard, to march and meet him.

sentences.zh: 秋七月乙丑，徙封殷王旭輪為豫王。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of autumn, on yichou, Prince Yin Xu Lun was transferred and enfeoffed as Prince of Yu.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou of the seventh autumn month Prince Yin Xu Lun was re-enfeoffed as Prince of Yu.

sentences.zh: 庚午，左侍極、檢校右相、嘉興子陸敦信緣老病乞辭機揆，拜大司成，兼知左侍極。

translations.literal: On gengwu Lu Dunxin, Left Attendant-at-the-Pivot and concurrent Right Chancellor, Baron of Jiaxing, citing age and illness begged to resign from the secretariat; he was appointed Grand Master of Accomplishment and retained concurrent charge of the Left Attendant-at-the-Pivot.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu Lu Dunxin, left chancellor and Baron of Jiaxing, pleaded age and illness to leave the secretariat; he was made grand master of accomplishment while keeping charge of the left attendant-at-the-pivot.

sentences.zh: 大司憲兼檢校右中護劉仁軌兼右相、檢校右中護。

translations.literal: Liu Rengui, Grand Master of Censors and concurrent Inspector of the Right Palace Guard, was made concurrent Right Chancellor and retained concurrent Inspector of the Right Palace Guard.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Rengui, grand master of censors and inspector of the right palace guard, became right chancellor and kept his guard post.

sentences.zh: 八月辛丑，兼司元太常伯、兼檢校左相、鉅鹿男竇德玄卒。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, on xinchou, Dou Dexuan, concurrent Chief of Ceremonial Affairs for the Directorate of Ritual and concurrent Left Chancellor, Baron of Julu, died.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou of the eighth month Dou Dexuan, left chancellor and Baron of Julu, died.

sentences.zh: 丁未，殺司衛少卿武惟良、淄州刺史武懷運，仍改姓蝮氏。

translations.literal: On dingwei Wu Weiliang, Vice Director of the Palace Guards, and Wu Huaiyun, prefect of Zi, were executed, and their surname was changed to Fu.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei Wu Weiliang, vice director of the palace guards, and Wu Huaiyun, prefect of Zi, were put to death and their clan name changed to Fu.

sentences.zh: 冬十月己酉，命司空、英國公勣為遼東道行軍大總管，以伐高麗。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of winter, on jiyou, Li Ji, Minister of Works and Duke of Ying, was ordered as Grand Commander of the Liaodong Field Army to attack Goguryeo.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou of the tenth winter month Li Ji, Duke of Ying and minister of works, was named grand commander of the Liaodong field army to attack Goguryeo.

sentences.zh: 乾封二年二年春正月丁丑，以去冬至於是月無雨雪，避正殿，減膳，親錄囚徒。

translations.literal: In the first month of spring of the second year of Qianfeng, on dingchou, because from last winter solstice until this month there had been no rain or snow, he avoided the main hall, reduced his meals, and personally reviewed prisoners.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou of the first spring month in Qianfeng 2, with no rain or snow since the previous winter solstice, the emperor left the main hall, ate sparingly, and reviewed prisoners in person.

sentences.zh: 罷乾封錢，復行開元通寶錢。

translations.literal: Qianfeng cash was abolished and Kaiyuan Tongbao cash was restored.
translations.idiomatic: Qianfeng coins were withdrawn and Kaiyuan Tongbao coinage restored.

sentences.zh: 二月戊戌，涪陵郡王愔薨。

translations.literal: In the second month, on wuxu, Prince of Fuling Li Yin died.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu of the second month Prince of Fuling Li Yin died.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，改萬年宮依舊名九成宮。

translations.literal: On xinchou Wannian Palace was restored to its former name Jiucheng Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou Wannian Palace reverted to its old name, Jiucheng Palace.

sentences.zh: 夏六月乙卯，西臺侍郎楊武，西臺侍郎、道國公、檢校太子左中護戴至德，正諫議大夫、檢校東臺侍郎、安平郡公李安期，東臺侍郎張文瓘，並同東西臺三品。

translations.literal: In the sixth month of summer, on yimao, Yang Wu, Vice Director of the Western Terrace; Dai Zhide, Vice Director of the Western Terrace, Duke of Daiguo, and concurrent Inspector of the Heir's Left Palace Guard; Li Anqi, Rectifier of Remonstrance and concurrent Vice Director of the Eastern Terrace, Duke of Anping; and Zhang Wenguan, Vice Director of the Eastern Terrace, were all made of equal rank to the Three Offices of the Eastern and Western Terraces.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao of the sixth summer month Yang Wu; Dai Zhide, Duke of Daiguo and inspector of the heir's left guard; Li Anqi, Duke of Anping; and Zhang Wenguan—all vice directors of the eastern or western terrace—were made equal in rank to the three offices of both terraces.

sentences.zh: 秋八月己丑朔，日有蝕之。

translations.literal: In the eighth month of autumn, on the jichou new moon, there was an eclipse of the sun.
translations.idiomatic: On the jichou new moon of the eighth autumn month the sun was eclipsed.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，東臺侍郎李安期出為荊州大都督府長史。

translations.literal: On bingchen Li Anqi, Vice Director of the Eastern Terrace, was sent out as chief administrator of the Jingzhou metropolitan area.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen Li Anqi, eastern-terrace vice director, was posted as chief administrator of Jingzhou.

sentences.zh: 總章元年三年春正月庚寅，詔繕工大監兼瀚海都護劉審禮為西域道安撫大使。

translations.literal: In the first year of Zongzhang, in the first month of spring, on gengyin, an edict appointed Liu Shenli, Grand Supervisor of Repairs and concurrent Protector-General of Hanhai, Pacification Commissioner on the Western Regions route.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin of the first spring month in Zongzhang 1 an edict named Liu Shenli, grand supervisor of repairs and protector-general of Hanhai, pacification commissioner for the western regions.

sentences.zh: 壬子，以右相劉仁軌為遼東道副大總管。

translations.literal: On renzi Liu Rengui, Right Chancellor, was made Deputy Grand Commander on the Liaodong route.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi Liu Rengui, right chancellor, became deputy grand commander on the Liaodong front.

sentences.zh: 二月戊午，遼東道破薛賀水五萬人，陣斬首五千餘級，獲生口三萬餘人，器械牛馬不可勝計。

translations.literal: On wuwu of the second month the Liaodong army routed fifty thousand men at Xuehe-shui, beheaded more than five thousand in the battle line, took more than thirty thousand captives, and seized weapons, cattle, and horses beyond counting.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu of the second month the Liaodong army shattered fifty thousand men at Xuehe-shui, took five thousand heads in the field, more than thirty thousand prisoners, and countless arms, cattle, and horses.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，以明堂制度歷代不同，漢、魏以還，彌更訛舛，遂增損古今，新制其圖。

translations.literal: On bingyin, because the Bright Hall system differed through the ages and since Han and Wei had grown ever more erroneous, additions and subtractions were made from antiquity and the present and a new design was drawn.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin, finding Bright Hall regulations inconsistent across dynasties and ever more corrupt since Han and Wei, the court revised ancient and modern models and drew a new plan.

sentences.zh: 下詔大赦，改元為總章元年。

translations.literal: An edict proclaimed a general amnesty and changed the era name to Zongzhang 1.
translations.idiomatic: The court proclaimed a general amnesty and renamed the era Zongzhang 1.

sentences.zh: 二月戊寅，幸九成宮。

translations.literal: On wuyin of the second month he visited Jiucheng Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin of the second month he went to Jiucheng Palace.

sentences.zh: 己卯，分長安、萬年置乾封、明堂二縣，分理於京城之中。

translations.literal: On jimao Chang'an and Wannian were each divided to establish Qianfeng and Mingtang counties, administering separately within the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao Chang'an and Wannian were split to form Qianfeng and Mingtang counties, each governing a portion of the capital.

sentences.zh: 癸未，皇太子弘釋奠於國學。

translations.literal: On guiwei Crown Prince Hong performed the libation sacrifice at the Directorate of Education.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei Crown Prince Hong offered the libation at the imperial academy.

sentences.zh: 贈顏回太子少師，曾參太子少保。

translations.literal: Yan Hui was posthumously enfeoffed as Junior Tutor to the Heir Apparent and Zeng Shen as Junior Mentor to the Heir Apparent.
translations.idiomatic: Yan Hui was posthumously named junior tutor to the heir and Zeng Shen junior mentor to the heir.

sentences.zh: 夏四月丙辰，有彗星見於畢、昴之間。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of summer, on bingchen, a comet appeared between the constellations Bi and Mao.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen of the fourth summer month a comet appeared between Bi and Mao.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，上避正殿，減膳，詔內外群官各上封事，極言過失。

translations.literal: On yichou the emperor avoided the main hall and reduced his meals, ordering civil and military officials inside and outside to submit sealed memorials speaking fully of faults.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou he left the main hall, ate sparingly, and ordered officials throughout the court and provinces to submit sealed memorials detailing his faults.

sentences.zh: 於是群臣上言：「星雖孛而光芒小，此非國眚，不足上勞聖慮，請御正殿，復常饌。

translations.literal: Thereupon the ministers said, "Though the star is a broom-star its light is slight; this is no national calamity and need not trouble Your Sagely Thought—we beg you to resume the main hall and restore your regular meals."
translations.idiomatic: The ministers urged, "The comet is faint; this is no national disaster and should not weigh on Your Majesty—please return to the main hall and your usual fare."

sentences.zh: 」帝曰：「朕獲奉宗廟，撫臨億兆，謫見於天，誡朕之不德也，當責躬修德以禳之。

translations.literal: The emperor said, "Having received charge of the ancestral temples and governing the hundred millions, a reproof appears in heaven—a warning of my want of virtue; I should blame myself and cultivate virtue to expiate it."
translations.idiomatic: The emperor replied, "I hold the ancestral temples and govern the millions; heaven's warning shows my lack of virtue—I must examine myself and mend my conduct to avert it."

sentences.zh: 」群臣復進曰：「星孛於東北，此高麗將滅之徵。

translations.literal: The ministers advanced again, saying, "The broom-star in the northeast is a sign that Goguryeo will perish."
translations.idiomatic: They pressed again: "The comet in the northeast foretells Goguryeo's fall."

sentences.zh: 」帝曰：「高麗百姓，即朕之百姓也。

translations.literal: The emperor said, "The people of Goguryeo are my people.
translations.idiomatic: He answered, "The people of Goguryeo are my own people.

sentences.zh: 既為萬國之主，豈可推過於小蕃！

translations.literal: Having become lord of the myriad states, how can I shift blame onto a small border state!"
translations.idiomatic: As lord of all states, how can I lay heaven's blame on a petty frontier kingdom!"

sentences.zh: 」竟不從所請。

translations.literal: He would not accede to their request.
translations.idiomatic: He refused their plea.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，彗星滅。

translations.literal: On yihai the comet vanished.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai the comet disappeared.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，西臺侍郎楊武卒。

translations.literal: On xinsi Yang Wu, Vice Director of the Western Terrace, died.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi Yang Wu, western-terrace vice director, died.

sentences.zh: 秋八月癸酉，至自九成宮。

translations.literal: In the eighth month of autumn, on guiyou, he returned from Jiucheng Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou of the eighth autumn month he returned from Jiucheng Palace.

sentences.zh: 九月癸巳，司空、英國公勣破高麗，拔平壤城，擒其王高藏及其大臣男建等以歸。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on guisi, Li Ji, Duke of Ying, crushed Goguryeo, took Pyongyang, and brought back captive its king Go Jang and the minister Namgeon and others.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi of the ninth month Li Ji, Duke of Ying, broke Goguryeo, seized Pyongyang, and brought home King Go Jang, Namgeon, and other captives.

sentences.zh: 境內盡降，其城一百七十，戶六十九萬七千，以其地為安東都護府，分置四十二州。

translations.literal: The whole territory submitted; one hundred seventy walled places, 697,000 households; the land was made the Protectorate-General to Pacify the East, divided into forty-two prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: The whole country submitted—one hundred seventy walled towns and 697,000 households; the court made it the Protectorate-General to Pacify the East and divided it into forty-two prefectures.

sentences.zh: 總章二年二年春正月，封諸王嫡子皆為郡王。

translations.literal: In the second year of Zongzhang, in the first month of spring, all legitimate sons of princes were enfeoffed as kings of commanderies.
translations.idiomatic: In the first spring month of Zongzhang 2 every prince's eldest son by his principal wife was enfeoffed as a commandery king.

sentences.zh: 二月，東臺侍郎、同東西臺三品兼知左史事張文瓘署位，始入銜。

translations.literal: In the second month Zhang Wenguan, Vice Director of the Eastern Terrace, equal in rank to the Three Offices of the Eastern and Western Terraces and in charge of the Left Historiographer's office, took up his office and first entered the roster.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month Zhang Wenguan, eastern-terrace vice director of third rank and acting left historiographer, assumed his post and first took his seat in council.

sentences.zh: 三月，東臺侍郎郝處俊同東西臺三品。

translations.literal: In the third month Hao Chujun, Vice Director of the Eastern Terrace, was made equal in rank to the Three Offices.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month Hao Chujun, eastern-terrace vice director, was made equal in rank to the three offices.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，皇后親祀先蠶。

translations.literal: On guiyou the empress sacrificed in person to the Silkworm Ancestor.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou the empress personally offered to the Silkworm Ancestor.

sentences.zh: 夏四月乙酉，幸九成宮。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of summer, on yiyou, he visited Jiucheng Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou of the fourth summer month he went to Jiucheng Palace.

sentences.zh: 置司列少常伯、司戎少常伯各兩員。

translations.literal: Two associate chief directors of guests and two associate chief directors of military affairs were established.
translations.idiomatic: The court added two associate directors of guests and two associate directors of military affairs.

sentences.zh: 五月庚子，移高麗戶二萬八千二百，車一千八十乘，牛三千三百頭，馬二千九百匹，駝六十頭，將入內地，萊、營二州般次發遣，量配於江、淮以南及山南、並、涼以西諸州空閑處安置。

translations.literal: On gengzi 28,200 Goguryeo households, 1,080 carts, 3,300 oxen, 2,900 horses, and 60 camels were moved into the interior; Lai and Ying prefectures shipped them in relays and allotted them to vacant lands in provinces south of the Yangzi and Huai, in Shannan, and west of Bing and Liang.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi 28,200 Goguryeo households with 1,080 carts, 3,300 oxen, 2,900 horses, and 60 camels were resettled inland; Lai and Ying sent them in relays to empty lands south of the Yangzi and Huai, in Shannan, and west of Bing and Liang.

sentences.zh: 六月戊申朔，日有蝕之。

translations.literal: On the wushen new moon of the sixth month there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: On the wushen new moon of the sixth month the sun was eclipsed.

sentences.zh: 括州大風雨，海水泛溢永嘉、安固二縣城郭，漂百姓宅六千八百四十三區，溺殺人九千七十、牛五百頭，損田苗四千一百五十頃。

translations.literal: Kuo Prefecture had great wind and rain; seawater flooded the city walls of Yongjia and Angu counties, swept away 6,843 dwellings, drowned 9,070 people and 500 oxen, and damaged 4,150 qing of crops.
translations.idiomatic: A great storm struck Kuo Prefecture; the sea flooded Yongjia and Angu, destroying 6,843 homes, drowning 9,070 people and 500 oxen, and ruining 4,150 qing of fields.

sentences.zh: 冀州大水，漂壞居人廬舍數千家。

translations.literal: Ji Prefecture had great floods that washed away thousands of dwellings.
translations.idiomatic: Ji Prefecture suffered heavy floods that swept away thousands of homes.

sentences.zh: 並遣使賑給。

translations.literal: Envoys were sent to relieve both.
translations.idiomatic: The court sent envoys to aid both regions.

sentences.zh: 秋七月，劍南益、瀘、巂、茂、陵、邛、雅、綿、翼、維、始、簡、資、榮、隆、果、梓、普、遂等一十九州旱，百姓乏絕，總三十六萬七千六百九十戶，遣司珍大夫路勵行存問賑貸，癸巳，冀州大都督府奏，自六月十三日夜降雨，至二十日水深五尺，其夜暴水深一丈已上，壞屋一萬四千三百九十區，害田四千四百九十六頃。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of autumn, nineteen prefectures in Jiannan—Yi, Lu, Xi, Mao, Ling, Qiong, Ya, Mian, Yi, Wei, Shi, Jian, Zi, Rong, Long, Guo, Zi, Pu, Sui, and others—suffered drought; the people were destitute, totaling 367,690 households; Commissioner of Court Delicacies Lu Li was sent to inquire and relieve with loans; on guisi the Jizhou metropolitan command reported that from the night of the thirteenth day of the sixth month rain fell until the twentieth, the water five chi deep, that night a sudden flood more than one zhang deep, destroying 14,390 dwellings and damaging 4,496 qing of fields.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh autumn month drought struck nineteen Jiannan prefectures—Yi, Lu, Xi, Mao, Ling, Qiong, Ya, Mian, Yi, Wei, Shi, Jian, Zi, Rong, Long, Guo, Zi, Pu, Sui, and others—leaving 367,690 households in want; Lu Li, commissioner of court delicacies, was sent to inquire and lend relief; on guisi Jizhou reported rain from the night of the sixth month's thirteenth through the twentieth, waters five chi deep, then a flash flood over one zhang that wrecked 14,390 houses and spoiled 4,496 qing of cropland.

sentences.zh: 遣右衛大將軍、涼國公契苾何力為駕海道行軍大總管。

translations.literal: Qibi Heli, General-in-Chief of the Right Palace Guard and Duke of Liang, was sent as Grand Commander of the Sea-Route Field Army.
translations.idiomatic: Qibi Heli, general-in-chief of the right palace guard and Duke of Liang, was named grand commander of the sea-route field army.

sentences.zh: 秋八月甲戌，改瀚海都護府為安北都護府。

translations.literal: In the eighth month of autumn, on jiaxu, the Hanhai Protectorate was changed to the Protectorate-General to Pacify the North.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu of the eighth autumn month Hanhai protectorate became the Protectorate-General to Pacify the North.

sentences.zh: 九月己亥，發自九成宮。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on jihai, he departed Jiucheng Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai of the ninth month he left Jiucheng Palace.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，停華林頓，大蒐於岐。

translations.literal: On renyin he halted at Hualin and held a great hunt in Qi.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin he paused at Hualin and held a great hunt in Qi.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，至岐州。

translations.literal: On yisi he reached Qi Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi he arrived at Qi Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 高祖初仕隋為扶風太守，故曲赦岐州管內。

translations.literal: Because Gaozu first served the Sui as prefect of Fufeng, a special amnesty was granted within Qi Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Because Gaozu had first served the Sui as prefect of Fufeng, Qi Prefecture received a special amnesty.

sentences.zh: 高祖時胥徒隨材擢用，賜高年衣物粟帛各有差。

translations.literal: Corvée laborers from Gaozu's time were promoted according to talent, and the aged were given cloth, grain, and silk in varying measure.
translations.idiomatic: Corvée workers from Gaozu's day were promoted for ability, and the elderly received graded gifts of cloth, grain, and silk.

sentences.zh: 冬十月丁巳，至自九成宮。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of winter, on dingsi, he returned from Jiucheng Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi of the tenth winter month he returned from Jiucheng Palace.

sentences.zh: 十一月庚辰，發九州人夫，轉發太原倉米粟入京。

translations.literal: On gengchen of the eleventh month corvée men from the nine circuits were mobilized to transport grain from Taiyuan warehouses to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen of the eleventh month laborers from the nine circuits were levied to haul grain from Taiyuan granaries to the capital.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，徙封豫王旭輪為冀王，仍令單名輪。

translations.literal: On dinghai Prince of Yu Xu Lun was transferred and enfeoffed as Prince of Ji and ordered to bear the single name Lun.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai Prince of Yu Xu Lun was re-enfeoffed as Prince of Ji and ordered to use the single name Lun.

sentences.zh: 十二月戊申，司空、太子太師、英國公勣薨。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on wushen, Li Ji, Duke of Ying, Minister of Works and Grand Preceptor to the Heir Apparent, died.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen of the twelfth month Li Ji, Duke of Ying, minister of works and grand preceptor to the heir, died.

sentences.zh: 是冬無雪。

translations.literal: That winter there was no snow.
translations.idiomatic: That winter no snow fell.

sentences.zh: 咸亨元年三年春正月丁丑，右相、樂成男劉仁軌致仕。

translations.literal: In the first year of Xianheng, in the first month of spring, on dingchou, Liu Rengui, Right Chancellor, Baron of Lecheng, retired.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou of the first spring month in Xianheng 1 Liu Rengui, right chancellor and Baron of Lecheng, retired from office.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，列遼東地為州縣。

translations.literal: On xinmao the Liaodong territory was organized into provinces and counties.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao the Liaodong lands were mapped into prefectures and counties.

sentences.zh: 二月戊申，以旱，親錄囚徒，祈禱名山大川。

translations.literal: In the second month, on wushen, because of drought he personally reviewed prisoners and prayed at famous mountains and rivers.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen of the second month, with drought prevailing, he reviewed prisoners in person and prayed at famous mountains and rivers.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，日色出如赭。

translations.literal: On guichou the sun at its rising was the color of ochre.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou the sun rose the color of red ochre.

sentences.zh: 三月甲戌朔，大赦天下，改元為咸亨元年。

translations.literal: On the jiaxu new moon of the third month a general amnesty was proclaimed and the era name changed to Xianheng 1.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiaxu new moon of the third month the court proclaimed a general amnesty and renamed the era Xianheng 1.

sentences.zh: 三月丁丑，改蓬萊宮為含元殿。

translations.literal: On dingchou of the third month Penglai Palace was renamed Hanyuan Hall.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou of the third month the court renamed Penglai Palace as Hanyuan Hall.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，太子少師、同東西臺三品許敬宗致仕。

translations.literal: On renchen Xu Jingzong, Junior Tutor to the Heir Apparent and equal in rank to the Three Offices, retired.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen Xu Jingzong, junior tutor to the heir and of third rank at both terraces, retired.

sentences.zh: 夏四月，吐蕃寇陷白州等一十八州，又與於闐合眾襲龜茲撥換城，陷之。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of summer Tibet raided and seized eighteen prefectures including Baizhou, and together with Khotan attacked and took the Boluo fortress of Kucha.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth summer month Tibet raided and captured eighteen prefectures including Baizhou, and with Khotan stormed and took Kucha's Boluo fortress.

sentences.zh: 罷安西四鎮。

translations.literal: The Four Garrisons of Anxi were abolished.
translations.idiomatic: The Four Garrisons of Anxi were disbanded.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，以右威衛大將軍薛仁貴為邏娑道行軍大總管，右衛員外大將軍阿史那道真、左衛將軍郭待封為副，領兵五萬以擊吐蕃。

translations.literal: On xinhai, Right Majestic Guard General Xue Rengui was made Grand Commander of the Campaign on the Luosa Route; Right Guard Assistant General Ashina Daozhen and Left Guard General Guo Daifeng were made his deputies, leading fifty thousand troops to attack Tibet.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai Xue Rengui, right majestic guard general, was made grand commander of the Luosa campaign; Ashina Daozhen and Guo Daifeng were his deputies, with fifty thousand men to strike Tibet.

sentences.zh: 庚午，幸九成宮。

translations.literal: On gengwu, he visited Jiucheng Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu he went to Jiucheng Palace.

sentences.zh: 雍州大雨雹。

translations.literal: Yong Prefecture had great hail.
translations.idiomatic: Yong Prefecture was struck by heavy hail.

sentences.zh: 五月丙戌，詔曰：「諸州縣孔子廟堂及學館有破壞並先來未造者，遂使生徒無肄業之所，先師闕奠祭之儀，久致飄露，深非敬本。

translations.literal: On bingxu of the fifth month, an edict said: "Confucius temples and academies in districts and counties that are damaged or were never built leave students without places to study and the Former Master without sacrificial rites, long exposed to wind and rain—far from honoring the root of learning."
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu of the fifth month an edict lamented that broken or never-built Confucian temples and schools left students nowhere to study and the Master without rites, long rotting in the weather—far from honoring learning's root.

sentences.zh: 宜令所司速事營造。

translations.literal: "Let the relevant offices speedily undertake repairs and construction."
translations.idiomatic: "Let the responsible offices repair and build them at once."
[End of edict.]

sentences.zh: 六月壬寅朔，日有蝕之。

translations.literal: On renyin, the first day of the sixth month, there was an eclipse of the sun.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin, new moon of the sixth month, the sun was eclipsed.

sentences.zh: 秋七月戊子，前西臺侍郎李敬玄起復本職，仍依舊同東西臺三品。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of autumn, on wuzi, former Vice Director of the Western Terrace Li Jingxuan was recalled to his former post and still deliberated with the Eastern and Western Terraces as third rank.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi of the seventh autumn month Li Jingxuan, former vice director of the western terrace, was recalled and again deliberated with both terraces at third rank.

sentences.zh: 薛仁貴、郭待封至大非川，為吐蕃大將論欽陵所襲，大敗，仁貴等並坐除名。

translations.literal: Xue Rengui and Guo Daifeng reached the Dafei River and were ambushed by the Tibetan general Lun Qinling; they suffered a great defeat, and Rengui and the others were all stripped of office.
translations.idiomatic: At the Dafei River Xue Rengui and Guo Daifeng were ambushed by the Tibetan general Lun Qinling and routed; Rengui and his colleagues were all dismissed.

sentences.zh: 吐谷渾全國盡沒，唯慕容諾曷缽及其親信數千帳內屬，仍徙於靈州界。

translations.literal: The Tuyuhun kingdom was entirely lost; only Murong Nuohebo and several thousand tents of his close followers submitted and were relocated within Lingzhou.
translations.idiomatic: The Tuyuhun state perished; only Murong Nuohebo and a few thousand tents of his kin submitted and were resettled within Lingzhou.

sentences.zh: 八月甲子，至自九成宮。

translations.literal: On jiazi of the eighth month, he returned from Jiucheng Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi of the eighth month he returned from Jiucheng Palace.

sentences.zh: 梁州都督、趙王福薨。

translations.literal: Liangzhou Military Governor Prince Zhao Fu died.
translations.idiomatic: Prince Zhao Fu, military governor of Liang, died.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，以久旱，避正殿，尚食減膳。

translations.literal: On bingyin, citing long drought, he avoided the main hall and reduced his meals.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin, citing drought, he left the main hall and ate sparingly.

sentences.zh: 九月甲申，衛國夫人楊氏薨，贈魯國夫人，謚曰忠烈。

translations.literal: On jiashen of the ninth month, Lady of the State of Wei Yang died; she was posthumously made Lady of the State of Lu with the posthumous title Loyal and Ardent.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen of the ninth month Lady Yang of Wei died; she was posthumously made Lady of Lu with the title Loyal and Ardent.

sentences.zh: 閏月壬子，故贈司徒、周忠孝公士鷿贈太尉、太子太師、太原郡王，贈魯國忠烈太夫人贈太原王妃。

translations.literal: On renzi of the intercalary month, the late Grand Tutor Zhou Duke of Loyal Filial Piety Shiyu was posthumously made Grand Preceptor and Prince of Taiyuan; the late Lady of Loyal Ardency of Lu was posthumously made Princess of Taiyuan.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi of the intercalary month the late Grand Tutor Shiyu, Duke of Zhou, was posthumously made grand preceptor and Prince of Taiyuan, and the late Lady of Loyal Ardency of Lu was made Princess of Taiyuan.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，葬太原王妃，京官文武九品已上及外命婦，送至便橋宿次。

translations.literal: On jiayin, the Princess of Taiyuan was buried; civil and military officials of the ninth rank and above in the capital and outer-order consorts escorted her to the lodging at Bian Bridge.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin the Princess of Taiyuan was buried; capital officials of the ninth rank and above and outer-order consorts escorted her to the lodge at Bian Bridge.

sentences.zh: 冬十月癸酉，大雪，平地三尺餘，行人凍死者贈帛給棺木。

translations.literal: In the tenth winter month, on guiyou, great snow piled more than three chi on level ground; those who froze to death on the roads were given silk for coffins.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou of the tenth winter month snow lay more than three feet deep on level ground; those who froze on the roads were given silk for coffins.

sentences.zh: 令雍、同、華州貧窶之家，有年十五已下不能存活者，聽一切任人收養為男女，充驅使，皆不得將為奴婢。

translations.literal: An order to Yong, Tong, and Hua: poor households with children under fifteen unable to survive might give them to anyone to raise as sons or daughters for service—they must not be made slaves.
translations.idiomatic: Yong, Tong, and Hua were ordered: poor families with children under fifteen who could not be kept might place them with anyone as sons or daughters for service—but not as slaves.

sentences.zh: 丙申，太子右中護兼攝正諫大夫、同東西臺三品趙仁本為左肅機，罷知政事。

translations.literal: On bingshen, Right Protector of the Heir and Acting Rectifier of Remonstrance Zhao Renben was made Left Secretariat Director and removed from deliberations.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen Zhao Renben, right protector of the heir and acting rectifier, became left secretariat director and left the council.

sentences.zh: 十二月庚寅，諸司及百官各復舊名。

translations.literal: On gengyin of the twelfth month, all offices and officials reverted to their former names.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin of the twelfth month every office and title reverted to its former name.

sentences.zh: 是歲，天下四十餘州旱及霜蟲，百姓饑乏，關中尤甚。

translations.literal: This year more than forty districts suffered drought, frost, and insects; the people were hungry, especially in Guanzhong.
translations.idiomatic: That year more than forty prefectures suffered drought, frost, and locusts; the people went hungry, worst of all in Guanzhong.

sentences.zh: 詔令任往諸州逐食，仍轉江南租米以賑給之。

translations.literal: An edict allowed people to go to any district to seek food, and southern Jiang grain tax was diverted for relief.
translations.idiomatic: An edict let people travel to any prefecture for food and diverted Jiangnan rent grain for relief.

sentences.zh: 咸亨二年二年春正月乙巳，幸東都。

translations.literal: In the spring first month of the second year of Xianheng, on yisi, he went to the eastern capital.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi of the first spring month in Xianheng 2 he went to the eastern capital.

sentences.zh: 留皇太子弘於京監國，令侍臣戴至德、張文瓘、李敬玄等輔之。

translations.literal: He left Crown Prince Hong in the capital to oversee the state and ordered Attendant-in-Ordinary Dai Zhide, Zhang Wenguan, Li Jingxuan, and others to assist him.
translations.idiomatic: He left Crown Prince Hong in Chang'an to oversee the realm and ordered Dai Zhide, Zhang Wenguan, Li Jingxuan, and others to assist him.

sentences.zh: 唯以閻立本、郝處俊從。

translations.literal: Only Yan Liben and Hao Chujun accompanied him.
translations.idiomatic: Only Yan Liben and Hao Chujun went with him.

sentences.zh: 甲子，至東都。

translations.literal: On jiazi, he arrived at the eastern capital.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi he reached the eastern capital.

sentences.zh: 二月丁亥，雍州人梁金柱請出錢三千貫賑濟貧人。

translations.literal: On dinghai of the second month, Liang Jinzhu of Yong Prefecture offered three thousand strings of cash to relieve the poor.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai of the second month Liang Jinzhu of Yong offered three thousand strings of cash to feed the poor.

sentences.zh: 夏四月戊子，大風折木。

translations.literal: On wuzi of the fourth summer month, great wind broke trees.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi of the fourth summer month a great wind snapped trees.

sentences.zh: 六月戊寅，左散騎常侍兼檢校秘書、太子賓客、周國公武敏之以罪復本姓賀蘭氏，除名，流雷州。

translations.literal: On wuyin of the sixth month, Left Attendant-in-Ordinary, concurrent Inspector of the Secretariat, Guest of the Heir, Duke of Zhou Wu Minzhi was restored to his original surname Helan for his crime, dismissed, and exiled to Leizhou.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin of the sixth month Wu Minzhi, left attendant-in-ordinary, secretariat inspector, and heir's guest, Duke of Zhou, was stripped of the Wu surname, dismissed, and exiled to Lei for his crimes.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，以旱，親錄囚徒。

translations.literal: On dinghai, citing drought, he personally reviewed prisoners.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai, citing drought, he reviewed prisoners in person.

sentences.zh: 秋九月，地震。

translations.literal: In the autumn ninth month, there was an earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth autumn month the earth quaked.

sentences.zh: 司徒、潞州刺史、徐王元禮薨。

translations.literal: Grand Tutor, Governor of Lu, Prince Xu Yuanli died.
translations.idiomatic: Yuanli, Prince Xu, grand tutor and governor of Lu, died.

sentences.zh: 冬十月，搜揚明達禮樂之士。

translations.literal: In the tenth winter month, search was made for persons accomplished in ritual and music.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth winter month the court sought men skilled in ritual and music.

sentences.zh: 十一月甲午朔，日有蝕之。

translations.literal: On jiawu, new moon of the eleventh month, there was an eclipse of the sun.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu, new moon of the eleventh month, the sun was eclipsed.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，幸許、汝等州教習。

translations.literal: On gengxu, he visited Xu, Ru, and other districts for military drill.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu he toured Xu, Ru, and neighboring prefectures to review troops.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，冬狩，校獵於許州葉縣昆水之陽。

translations.literal: On guiyou, winter hunt; he inspected game on the south bank of the Kun River in Ye County, Xu Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou he held the winter hunt and coursed game on the south bank of the Kun in Ye, Xu Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 十二月丙戌，還東都。

translations.literal: On bingxu of the twelfth month, he returned to the eastern capital.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu of the twelfth month he returned to the eastern capital.

sentences.zh: 咸亨三年三年春正月辛丑，發梁、益等一十八州兵，募五千三百人，遣右衛副率梁積壽往姚州擊叛蠻。

translations.literal: In the spring first month of the third year of Xianheng, on xinchou, troops were raised from eighteen districts including Liang and Yi, five thousand three hundred men were recruited, and Right Guard Vice Commander Liang Jishou was sent to Yaozhou to attack rebel barbarians.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou of the first spring month in Xianheng 3 the court raised troops from eighteen circuits including Liang and Yi, enlisted five thousand three hundred men, and sent Liang Jishou, vice commander of the right guard, against the rebel tribes in Yaozhou.

sentences.zh: 辛未，制雍、洛二州人聽任本州官。

translations.literal: On xinwei, the people of Yong and Luo were allowed to serve officials of their home prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei the people of Yong and Luo were permitted to take office in their home prefectures.

sentences.zh: 二月己卯，侍中、永安郡公姜恪卒於河西鎮守。

translations.literal: On jimao, Attendant-in-Ordinary and Duke of Yong'an Jiang Ke died at the Hexi garrison.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao Jiang Ke, attendant-in-ordinary and Duke of Yong'an, died on the Hexi frontier.

sentences.zh: 夏四月戊寅，幸合璧宮。

translations.literal: On wuyin of the fourth summer month, he visited Hebi Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin of the fourth summer month he went to Hebi Palace.

sentences.zh: 壬午，於水南教旗。

translations.literal: On renwu, he trained banners south of the water.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu he drilled the banners south of the river.

sentences.zh: 上問中書令閻立本、黃門侍郎郝處俊：「伊尹負鼎俎於湯，應是補緝時政，不知鑄鼎所緣，復在何國？

translations.literal: The emperor asked Secretariat Director Yan Liben and Vice Director of the Yellow Gate Hao Chujun: "When Yi Yin carried the tripod and meat board to Tang, was that to repair government at a time of disorder—and where was the tripod cast, in what state?
translations.idiomatic: He asked Yan Liben and Hao Chujun: "When Yi Yin carried the cauldron and offering board to Tang, was he mending government in crisis—and where was that cauldron cast, in which realm?

sentences.zh: 將為國之重器，歷代傳寶？

translations.literal: Was it to be the state's great vessel, handed down through generations as treasure?"
translations.idiomatic: Was it meant as the realm's great treasure, passed down through the ages?"

sentences.zh: 」閻立本以古義對。

translations.literal: Yan Liben answered from ancient lore.
translations.idiomatic: Yan Liben answered from the ancient precedents.

sentences.zh: 五月乙未，五品已上改賜新魚袋，並飾以銀；

translations.literal: On yiwei of the fifth month, fifth rank and above were given new fish tally bags trimmed with silver;
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei of the fifth month officials of the fifth rank and above received new fish tally badges edged in silver;

sentences.zh: 三品已上各賜金裝刀子、礪石一具。

translations.literal: third rank and above each received a gold-mounted knife and whetstone.
translations.idiomatic: those of the third rank and above each received a gold-mounted knife and whetstone.

sentences.zh: 六月丙子，於洛州柏崖置倉。

translations.literal: On bingzi of the sixth month, a granary was established at Boya in Luozhou.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi of the sixth month a granary was set up at Boya in Luozhou.

sentences.zh: 八月壬子，特進、高陽郡公許敬宗卒。

translations.literal: On renzi of the eighth month, Special Grand Master and Duke of Gaoyang Xu Jingzong died.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi of the eighth month Xu Jingzong, special grand master and Duke of Gaoyang, died.

sentences.zh: 九月乙卯，冀州大都督府復為魏州，魏州復為冀州。

translations.literal: On maoyin of the ninth month, the Great Protectorate of Ji was restored to Weizhou, and Weizhou to Jizhou.
translations.idiomatic: On maoyin of the ninth month the Ji protectorate was restored to Weizhou and Weizhou to Jizhou.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，沛王賢徙封雍王。

translations.literal: On renyin, Prince Xian of Pei was transferred to Prince of Yong.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin Prince Xian of Pei was reassigned as Prince of Yong.

sentences.zh: 冬十月己未，皇太子監國。

translations.literal: On jiwei of the tenth month, the crown prince oversaw the state.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei of the tenth month the crown prince oversaw the realm.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，車駕還京師。

translations.literal: On renxu, the imperial carriage returned to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu the emperor returned to Chang'an.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，中書侍郎、同中書門下三品、道國公戴至德加兼戶部尚書，黃門侍郎、同中書門下三品張文瓘檢校大理卿，黃門侍郎、甑山縣公、同中書門下三品郝處俊為中書侍郎，兼檢校吏部侍郎、同中書門下三品李敬玄為吏部侍郎，並依舊同中書門下三品。

translations.literal: On yihai, Vice Director of the Masters of Writing and Duke of Daoguo Dai Zhide was additionally made Minister of Revenue; Vice Director of the Yellow Gate Zhang Wenguan was made Acting Director of the Court of Judicial Review; Vice Director of the Yellow Gate and Baron of Zhenshan Hao Chujun became Vice Director of the Masters of Writing; Vice Director of the Masters of Writing and Baron of Zhenshan Li Jingxuan became Vice Minister of Personnel—all still deliberated with the Secretariat and Chancellery as third rank.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai Dai Zhide, vice director and Duke of Daoguo, was also made minister of revenue; Zhang Wenguan, vice director of the yellow gate, acting director of judicial review; Hao Chujun, baron of Zhenshan, vice director of the masters of writing; Li Jingxuan, baron of Zhenshan, vice minister of personnel—all retaining third-rank deliberative standing.

sentences.zh: 十一月戊子朔，日有蝕之。

translations.literal: On wuzi, new moon of the eleventh month, there was an eclipse of the sun.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi, new moon of the eleventh month, the sun was eclipsed.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，至自東都。

translations.literal: On jiachen, he returned from the eastern capital.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen he returned from the eastern capital.

sentences.zh: 十二月癸卯，太子左庶子劉仁軌同中書門下三品。

translations.literal: On guimao, Left Chancellery Aide Liu Ren'gui was made third rank with the Secretariat and Chancellery.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao Liu Ren'gui, left chancellery aide, joined deliberations at third rank.

sentences.zh: 是冬，左監門大將軍高侃大敗新羅之眾於橫水。

translations.literal: This winter Left Gate Guard General Gao Kan routed the Silla army at Hengshui.
translations.idiomatic: That winter Gao Kan, left gate guard general, crushed the Silla host at Hengshui.

sentences.zh: 咸亨四年四年春正月甲午，詔咸亨初收養為男女及驅使者，聽量酬衣食之直，放還本處。

translations.literal: In the spring first month of the fourth year of Xianheng, on jiawu, an edict said: "Those taken in as sons, daughters, or servants under the Xianheng 1 relief policy may be paid the cost of food and clothing and released to their home districts."
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu of the first spring month in Xianheng 4 an edict ruled that children taken in for service under the Xianheng 1 famine policy might be redeemed for the cost of their keep and sent home.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，絳州刺史、鄭王元懿薨。

translations.literal: On bingchen, Governor of Jiang and Prince of Zheng Yuanyi died.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen Yuanyi, Prince of Zheng and governor of Jiang, died.

sentences.zh: 二月壬午，以左金吾將軍裴居道女為皇太子弘妃。

translations.literal: On renwu of the second month, the daughter of Left Golden Guard General Pei Judao was made consort to Crown Prince Hong.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu of the second month Pei Judao's daughter, of the left golden guard, became Crown Prince Hong's consort.

sentences.zh: 夏四月丙子，幸九成宮。

translations.literal: On bingzi of the fourth summer month, he visited Jiucheng Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi of the fourth summer month he went to Jiucheng Palace.

sentences.zh: 閏五月丁卯，燕山道總管李謹行破高麗叛黨於瓠盧河之西，高麗平壤餘眾遁入新羅。

translations.literal: On dingmao of the intercalary fifth month, Yanshan Route Commander Li Jinxing defeated Goguryeo rebels west of the Hulu River; the remaining forces of Pyongyang fled into Silla.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao of the intercalary fifth month Li Jinxing, commander of the Yanshan route, routed Goguryeo rebels west of the Hulu; Pyongyang's remnant forces fled into Silla.

sentences.zh: 秋七月庚午，九成宮太子新宮成，上召五品已上諸親宴太子宮，極歡而罷。

translations.literal: On gengwu of the seventh month, the crown prince's new palace at Jiucheng was completed; the emperor summoned fifth-rank kin and above to feast in the prince's palace and rejoiced until night.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu of the seventh month the heir's new palace at Jiucheng was finished; he summoned fifth-rank kin and above to feast there and caroused until night.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，婺州暴雨，水泛溢，漂溺居民六百家，詔令賑給。

translations.literal: On xinsi, Wuzhou was struck by violent rain and flooding; six hundred households were drowned; an edict ordered relief.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi cloudbursts at Wuzhou drowned six hundred households; the court ordered relief.

sentences.zh: 八月辛丑，上痁疾，令太子受諸司啟事。

translations.literal: On xinchou of the eighth month, the emperor fell ill with malaria and ordered the crown prince to receive memorials from all offices.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou of the eighth month the emperor took to his bed with malaria and had the heir receive memorials from every office.

sentences.zh: 己酉，大風毀太廟鴟吻。

translations.literal: On jiwei, a great wind destroyed the ridge ornaments of the Ancestral Temple.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei a gale tore the Ancestral Temple's ridge ornaments from the roof.

sentences.zh: 冬十月壬午，中書令、博陵縣子閻立本卒。

translations.literal: On renwu of the tenth month, Secretariat Director and Baron of Boling Yan Liben died.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu of the tenth month Yan Liben, secretariat director and Baron of Boling, died.

sentences.zh: 乙未，皇太子弘納妃畢，曲赦岐州，大酺三日。

translations.literal: On yiwei, when the crown prince's wedding rites were complete, a partial amnesty was granted to Qi Prefecture and a great feast lasted three days.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei, when the heir's wedding was complete, the court pardoned Qi and feasted for three days.

sentences.zh: 庚子，還京師。

translations.literal: On gengzi, he returned to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi he returned to Chang'an.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，至自九成宮。

translations.literal: On yisi, he returned from Jiucheng Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi he came back from Jiucheng Palace.

sentences.zh: 十一月丙寅，上制樂章，有《上元》、《二儀》、《三才》、《四時》、《五行》、《六律》、《七政》、《八風》、《九宮》、《十洲》、《得一》、《慶雲》之曲，詔有司諸大祠享即奏之。

translations.literal: On bingyin of the eleventh month, the emperor composed musical pieces including "Supreme Origin," "Two Modes," "Three Powers," "Four Seasons," "Five Phases," "Six Tones," "Seven Regulators," "Eight Winds," "Nine Palaces," "Ten Isles," "Attaining Unity," and "Auspicious Clouds," and ordered them played at all great sacrifices.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin of the eleventh month he composed twelve suite pieces—from "Supreme Origin" through "Auspicious Clouds"—and ordered them played at every great sacrifice.

sentences.zh: 十二月丙午，弓月、疏勒二國王入朝請降。

translations.literal: On bingwu of the twelfth month, the kings of Gongyue and Shule came to court to submit.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu of the twelfth month the kings of Gongyue and Shule came to submit.

sentences.zh: 上元元年五年春二月壬午，遣太子左庶子、同中書門下三品劉仁軌為雞林道大總管，以討新羅，仍令衛尉卿李弼、右領大將軍李謹行副之。

translations.literal: In the spring second month of the first year of Shangyuan, on renwu, Left Chancellery Aide Liu Ren'gui was made Grand Commander of the Jilin Route to attack Silla, with Commandant of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices Li Bi and Right Collar Guard General Li Jinxing as his deputies.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu of the second spring month in Shangyuan 1 Liu Ren'gui, left chancellery aide, was made grand commander of the Jilin campaign against Silla, with Li Bi and Li Jinxing as deputies.

sentences.zh: 三月辛亥朔，日有蝕之。

translations.literal: On xinhai, new moon of the third month, there was an eclipse of the sun.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai, new moon of the third month, the sun was eclipsed.

sentences.zh: 己巳，皇后祀先蠶。

translations.literal: On jisi, the empress sacrificed to the Silkworm Ancestor.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi the empress sacrificed to the silkworm ancestor.

sentences.zh: 夏四月辛卯，以尚輦奉御、周國公武承嗣為宗正卿。

translations.literal: On xinmao of the fourth summer month, Palace Chariot Attendant and Duke of Zhou Wu Chengsi was made Director of the Imperial Clan.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao of the fourth summer month Wu Chengsi, palace chariot attendant and Duke of Zhou, became director of the imperial clan.

sentences.zh: 五月己未，詔：「春秋二社，本以祈農，如聞此外別為邑會。

translations.literal: On jiwei of the fifth month, an edict said: "The spring and autumn she sacrifices were instituted to pray for the harvest; we hear that apart from these, separate village gatherings are held.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei of the fifth month an edict said: "The spring and autumn she rites exist to pray for the harvest, yet apart from them villages hold their own gatherings.

sentences.zh: 此後除二社外，不得聚集，有司嚴加禁止。

translations.literal: Henceforth, apart from the two she days, no gatherings are permitted; the relevant offices are strictly to forbid them."
translations.idiomatic: From now on, save the two she days, no such assemblies are allowed; the offices must forbid them strictly."
[End of edict.]

sentences.zh: 六月壬寅，太白入東井。

translations.literal: On renyin of the sixth month, the White Planet entered the Eastern Well.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin of the sixth month Venus entered the Well mansion.

sentences.zh: 秋八月壬辰，追尊宣簡公為宣皇帝，懿王為光皇帝，太祖武皇帝為高祖神堯皇帝，太宗文皇帝為文武聖皇帝，太穆皇后為太穆神皇后，文德皇后為文德聖皇后。

translations.literal: On renchen of the eighth month, Duke of Manifest Simplicity was posthumously honored as Manifest Emperor, Prince of Manifest Virtue as Radiant Emperor, Martial Emperor the Founding Ancestor as High Ancestor Divine Yao Emperor, Literary Emperor the Founding Ancestor as Civil and Martial Sage Emperor, Grand Empress of Grand Tranquility as Grand Tranquility Divine Empress, and Empress of Literary Virtue as Literary Virtue Sage Empress; the emperor was styled Heavenly Sovereign and the empress Heavenly Empress.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen of the eighth month the court raised posthumous imperial titles for the founders through Taizong and their consorts, styled the emperor Heavenly Sovereign and the empress Heavenly Empress.

sentences.zh: 皇帝稱天皇，皇后稱天後。

translations.literal: Xianheng 5 was changed to Shangyuan 1, and a great amnesty was proclaimed.
translations.idiomatic: The era was changed from Xianheng 5 to Shangyuan 1 and a general amnesty was proclaimed.

sentences.zh: 改咸亨五年為上元元年，大赦。

translations.literal: On wuxu, an edict ordered that civil and military officials of the third rank and above wear purple with jade belts;
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu an edict fixed court dress: third rank and above wore purple with jade belts;

sentences.zh: 戊戌，敕文武官三品己上服紫，金玉帶；

translations.literal: fourth rank deep scarlet, fifth rank pale scarlet, all with gold belts;
translations.idiomatic: fourth rank deep scarlet, fifth pale scarlet, both with gold belts;

sentences.zh: 四品深緋，五品淺緋，並金帶；

translations.literal: sixth rank deep green, seventh rank pale green, all with silver belts;
translations.idiomatic: sixth deep green, seventh pale green, both with silver belts;

sentences.zh: 六品深綠，七品淺綠，並銀帶；

translations.literal: eighth rank deep blue, ninth rank pale blue, with pewter belts;
translations.idiomatic: eighth deep blue, ninth pale blue, with pewter belts;

sentences.zh: 八品深青，九品淺青，鍮石帶；

translations.literal: commoners wore yellow with copper and iron belts.
translations.idiomatic: commoners wore yellow with copper or iron belts.

sentences.zh: 庶人服黃，銅鐵帶。

translations.literal: Civil officials of the first rank and below all carried hand towels, counting bags, knives, and whetstones; military officials might carry them if they wished.
translations.idiomatic: Civil officials through the first rank carried hand towels, counting bags, knives, and whetstones; military men might do the same if they chose.

sentences.zh: 一品已下文官，並帶手巾、算袋、刀子、礪石，武官欲帶亦聽之。

translations.literal: On xinhai of the ninth month, the hundred officials wore the new robes and the emperor feasted them at Lindde Hall.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai of the ninth month the bureaucracy donned the new robes and he feasted them at Lindde Hall.

sentences.zh: 九月辛亥，百僚具新服，上宴之於麟德殿。

translations.literal: On guichou, Zhangsun Wuji's offices and titles were posthumously restored; his great-grandson Yi was enfeoffed Duke of Zhao and permitted burial in the tomb prepared for him at Zhaoling.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou Zhangsun Wuji's rank was posthumously restored; his great-grandson Yi inherited the Dukedom of Zhao and was allowed burial in the grave prepared for him at Zhaoling.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，追復長孫無忌官爵，仍以其曾孫翼襲封趙國公，許歸葬於昭陵先造之墳。

translations.literal: On bingwu, new moon of the eleventh month, he went to the eastern capital.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu, the new moon of the eleventh month, he set out for the eastern capital.

sentences.zh: 十一月丙午朔，幸東都。

translations.literal: On jiyou, he hunted at Quwuyuan on Mount Hua.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou he hunted at Quwuyuan on Mount Hua.

sentences.zh: 己酉，狩於華山之曲武原。

translations.literal: On wuchen, he arrived at the eastern capital.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen he reached the eastern capital.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，至東都。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, Prince Jiang Yun died.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month Prince Jiang of Jiang died.

sentences.zh: 十二月，蔣王惲薨。

translations.literal: On wuzi, the king of Khotan, Fuzhan Xiong, came to court.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi Fuzhan Xiong, king of Khotan, came to court.

sentences.zh: 戊子，於闐王伏闍雄來朝。

translations.literal: On xinmao, the king of Persia, Peroz, came to court.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao Peroz, king of Persia, came to court.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，波斯王卑路斯來朝。

translations.literal: On xinmao, the king of Persia, Peroz, came to court.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao Peroz, king of Persia, came to court.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，天後上意見十二條，請王公百僚皆習《老子》，每歲明經一準《孝經》、《論語》例試於有司。

translations.literal: On renyin, the Heavenly Empress presented twelve proposals: she asked that princes, dukes, and the hundred officials all study the Laozi, and that each year one classics candidate be examined on the Classic of Filial Piety and Analects by the same rule as the classics examination.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin the Heavenly Empress submitted twelve proposals: that the nobility and bureaucracy study the Laozi, and that each year one classics candidate be tested on the Classic of Filial Piety and the Analects under the same rule as the regular examination.

sentences.zh: 又請子父在為母服三年。

translations.literal: She also asked that when father and son were both alive, one serve one's mother in mourning for three years.
translations.idiomatic: She also asked that while father and son both lived, a son mourn his mother for three years.

sentences.zh: 虢王鳳薨。

translations.literal: The Prince of Guo, Feng, died.
translations.idiomatic: Prince Feng of Guo died.

sentences.zh: 上元二年二年春正月甲寅，熒惑犯房。

translations.literal: In the second year of Shangyuan, spring first month, on jiayin, Mars intruded into the Fang mansion.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Shangyuan, on jiayin of the first spring month, Mars crossed the Fang asterism.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，支汗郡王獻碧玻璃。

translations.literal: On renxu, the Prince of Zhi Han presented blue-green glass.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu the Prince of Zhi Han presented blue-green glass.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，以於闐為毗沙都督府，以尉遲伏闍雄為毗沙都督，分其境內為十州，以伏闍雄有擊吐蕃功故也。

translations.literal: On bingyin, Khotan was made the Pacified Sands Protectorate; Yuchi Fuzhe Xiong was made Pacified Sands Protector; within its territory ten prefectures were established — because Fuzhe Xiong had merit in attacking Tibet.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin Khotan became the Pacified Sands Protectorate under Yuchi Fuzhe Xiong, its lands divided into ten prefectures in reward for his campaign against Tibet.

sentences.zh: 庚午，龜茲王白素稽獻銀頗羅。

translations.literal: On gengwu, King Baisuqi of Kucha presented silver poluo bowls.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu King Baisuqi of Kucha presented silver poluo bowls.

sentences.zh: 辛未，吐蕃遣其大臣論吐渾彌來請和，不許。

translations.literal: On xinwei, Tibet sent its minister Lun Tuhunmi to sue for peace; it was not granted.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei Tibet sent the minister Lun Tuhunmi to sue for peace; the court refused.

sentences.zh: 二月，雞林道行軍大總管大破新羅之眾於七重城，斬獲甚眾。

translations.literal: In the second month, the Silla-route campaigning grand general greatly defeated Silla forces at Sevenfold Fortress, beheading and capturing in great number.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month the grand general of the Silla expedition routed Silla at Sevenfold Fortress, taking a great slaughter of heads and captives.

sentences.zh: 新羅遣使入朝獻方物，伏罪。

translations.literal: Silla sent envoys to court presenting local products and confessing guilt.
translations.idiomatic: Silla sent envoys to court with tribute and a plea for pardon.

sentences.zh: 赦之，復其王金法敏官爵。

translations.literal: They were pardoned, and King Kim Popsin's rank and title were restored.
translations.idiomatic: The court pardoned them and restored King Kim Popsin to his rank and title.

sentences.zh: 三月丁未，日色如赭。

translations.literal: In the third month, on dingwei, the sun's color was like ochre.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei of the third month the sun burned ochre-red.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，天后親蠶於邙山之陽。

translations.literal: On dingsi, the Empress personally conducted sericulture on the south slope of Mount Mang.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi the Empress performed the spring silkworm rite on the sunny side of Mount Mang.

sentences.zh: 時帝風疹不能聽朝，政事皆決於天後。

translations.literal: At this time the Emperor had wind-rash and could not hear court; all government affairs were decided by the Empress.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor was laid low by wind-rash and could not hold court; the Empress decided every affair of state.

sentences.zh: 自誅上官儀後，上每視朝，天後垂簾於御座後，政事大小皆預聞之，內外稱為「二聖」。

translations.literal: From the execution of Shangguan Yi onward, whenever the Emperor attended court the Empress hung a curtain behind the imperial seat; great and small government she heard in advance, and within and without they were called the "Two Sages."
translations.idiomatic: After Shangguan Yi was put to death, the Empress sat behind a curtain at every audience while the Emperor held court; nothing large or small was decided without her, and the realm spoke of the "Two Sages."

sentences.zh: 帝欲下詔令天后攝國政，中書侍郎郝處俊諫止之。

translations.literal: The Emperor wished to issue an edict ordering the Empress to act as regent of the state; Secretariat Vice Director Hao Chujun remonstrated and stopped it.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor meant to decree that the Empress govern as regent; Hao Chujun, vice director of the Secretariat, remonstrated until he abandoned the plan.

sentences.zh: 夏四月，分括州永嘉、永固二縣置溫州，析臨海縣為樂安、永寧二縣。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month: from Kuozhou the two counties Yongjia and Yonggu were separated to establish Wenzhou; from Linhai County were split the two counties Le'an and Yongning.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth summer month Yongjia and Yonggu were split from Kuozhou to form Wenzhou, and Linhai was divided into Le'an and Yongning counties.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，周王顯妃趙氏以罪幽死。

translations.literal: On xinsi, Consort Zhao, consort of Prince Xian of Zhou, was imprisoned and died for crime.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi Consort Zhao, wife of Prince Xian of Zhou, was confined for her crimes and died in custody.

sentences.zh: 己亥，皇太子弘薨於合璧宮之綺雲殿。

translations.literal: On jihai, Crown Prince Hong died at the Qiyun Hall of Hebi Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai Crown Prince Hong died in the Qiyun Hall at Hebi Palace.

sentences.zh: 時帝幸合璧宮，是日還東都。

translations.literal: At the time the Emperor was visiting Hebi Palace; that day he returned to the Eastern Capital.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor was at Hebi Palace that day and returned to the Eastern Capital the same evening.

sentences.zh: 五月己亥，追謚太子弘為孝敬皇帝。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on jihai, Crown Prince Hong was posthumously titled Emperor Xiaojing.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on jihai, Crown Prince Hong was posthumously honored as Emperor Xiaojing.

sentences.zh: 六月戊寅，以雍王賢為皇太子，大赦。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on wuyin, Prince Xian of Yong was made crown prince; great amnesty.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on wuyin, Prince Xian of Yong was made heir apparent and the court proclaimed a general amnesty.

sentences.zh: 秋七月辛亥，洛州復置緱氏縣，以管孝敬皇帝恭陵。

translations.literal: In the seventh autumn month, on xinhai, Gongshi County was re-established in Luozhou to administer Emperor Xiaojing's Gong Mausoleum.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month, on xinhai, Luozhou regained Gongshi County to oversee Emperor Xiaojing's mausoleum.

sentences.zh: 慈州刺史、杞王上金坐事，於澧州安置。

translations.literal: Prince Shangjin of Qi, prefect of Ci, was punished for his offense and settled at Lizhou.
translations.idiomatic: Prince Shangjin of Qi, prefect of Ci, was punished for his crimes and exiled to Lizhou.

sentences.zh: 八月庚子，太子左庶子、同中書門下三品、樂成侯劉仁軌為左僕射，依舊監修國史。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, on gengzi, Crown Prince Left Senior Mentor, third-grade co-equal with Secretariat and Chancellery, Marquis of Lecheng Liu Rengui became Left Vice Director of the Masters of Writing, still supervising revision of the national history.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi of the eighth month Liu Rengui, Marquis of Lecheng and senior mentor to the heir, became left vice director of the Masters of Writing while continuing to supervise the national history.

sentences.zh: 中書門下三品、大理卿張文瓘為侍中。

translations.literal: Third-grade co-equal with Secretariat and Chancellery, Minister of Justice Zhang Wenqian became Palace Attendant.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Wenqian, minister of justice and chief minister, became palace attendant.

sentences.zh: 中書侍郎、同三品、甑山公郝處俊為中書令，監修國史如故。

translations.literal: Secretariat Vice Director, third-grade co-equal, Marquis of Zhenshan Hao Chujun became Secretariat Director, supervising revision of the national history as before.
translations.idiomatic: Hao Chujun, Marquis of Zhenshan and vice director of the Secretariat, was made director while retaining charge of the national history.

sentences.zh: 吏部侍郎、檢校太子左庶子、監修國史李敬玄吏部尚書兼太子左庶子、同中書門下三品，依前監修國史。

translations.literal: Ministry of Personnel Vice Director, acting Crown Prince Left Senior Mentor, supervising revision of the national history Li Jingxuan became Ministry of Personnel Director concurrent Crown Prince Left Senior Mentor, third-grade co-equal with Secretariat and Chancellery, still supervising revision of the national history as before.
translations.idiomatic: Li Jingxuan was promoted to minister of personnel and left senior mentor to the heir, joining the chief ministers while still supervising the national history.

sentences.zh: 左丞許圉師為戶部尚書。

translations.literal: Left Vice Director Xu Yuanshi became Minister of Revenue.
translations.idiomatic: Left vice director Xu Yuanshi was appointed minister of revenue.

sentences.zh: 九月丙午，宰相劉仁軌、戴至德、張文瓘、郝處俊並兼太子賓客。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on bingwu, the chancellors Liu Rengui, Dai Zhide, Zhang Wenqian, and Hao Chujun all concurrently became crown-prince guests.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on bingwu, Liu Rengui, Dai Zhide, Zhang Wenqian, and Hao Chujun were each named guest to the crown prince.

sentences.zh: 冬十月，析永州營道、江華、唐興三縣置道州。

translations.literal: In the tenth winter month, from Yongzhou the three counties Yingdao, Jianghua, and Tangxing were separated to establish Daozhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month Yingdao, Jianghua, and Tangxing were split from Yongzhou to form Daozhou.

sentences.zh: 壬午，星孛於角、亢之南，長五尺。

translations.literal: On renwu, a broom star appeared south of the Horn and Neck mansions, five chi in length.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu a comet blazed south of the Horn and Neck asterisms, its tail five feet long.

sentences.zh: 十二月丁亥，龜茲王白素稽獻名馬。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on dinghai, King Baisuqi of Kucha presented famous horses.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on dinghai, King Baisuqi of Kucha presented fine horses.

sentences.zh: 儀鳳元年三年春正月戊戌，徙封冀王輪為相王。

translations.literal: In the first year of Yifeng, spring first month, on wuxu, enfeoffment of Prince Lun of Ji was changed to Prince of Xiang.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Yifeng, on wuxu of the first spring month, Prince Lun of Ji was retitled Prince of Xiang.

sentences.zh: 二月甲戌，移安東都護府於遼東。

translations.literal: In the second month, on jiaxu, the Andong Protectorate was moved to Liaodong.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on jiaxu, the Andong Protectorate was transferred to Liaodong.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，堅昆獻名馬。

translations.literal: On yihai, the Kirghiz presented famous horses.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai the Kirghiz presented fine horses.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，幸汝州之溫湯。

translations.literal: On dinghai, he visited the hot springs of Ruzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai the Emperor went to the hot springs at Ruzhou.

sentences.zh: 三月癸卯，黃門侍郎來恆、中書侍郎薛元超並同中書門下三品。

translations.literal: In the third month, on guimao, Yellow Gate Vice Director Lai Heng and Secretariat Vice Director Xue Yuanchao both became third-grade co-equal with Secretariat and Chancellery.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao of the third month Lai Heng and Xue Yuanchao were each raised to chief ministers of the third grade.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，還東都。

translations.literal: On jiachen, the imperial carriage returned to the Eastern Capital.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen he returned to the Eastern Capital.

sentences.zh: 閏三月己巳朔，吐蕃入寇鄯、廓、河、芳等四州。

translations.literal: Intercalary third month, on jisi new moon, Tibet invaded Shan, Guo, He, and Fang and other four prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: On the jisi new moon of the intercalary third month Tibet raided Shan, Guo, He, and Fang prefectures.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，洛州牧、周王顯為洮州道行軍元帥，領工部尚書劉審禮等十二總管；

translations.literal: On yiyou, Luozhou governor Prince Xian of Zhou was made commander-in-chief of the Taozhou route, with Minister of Works Liu Shenli and eleven other commanders;
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou Prince Xian of Zhou, governor of Luozhou, was named commander-in-chief of the Taozhou expedition, with Liu Shenli, minister of works, and eleven other generals under him;

sentences.zh: 並州都督、相王輪為涼州道行軍元帥，領左衛將軍契苾何力等軍，以討吐蕃。

translations.literal: Bingzhou governor Prince Lun of Xiang was made commander-in-chief of the Liangzhou route, leading Left Guard General Qibi Heli and other armies to attack Tibet.
translations.idiomatic: Prince Lun of Xiang, governor of Bingzhou, was made commander of the Liangzhou route with Qibi Heli of the Left Guards and other forces to strike Tibet.

sentences.zh: 二王竟不行。

translations.literal: Neither prince in the end went.
translations.idiomatic: Neither prince marched in the end.

sentences.zh: 戊午，敕制比用白紙，多為蟲蠹，今後尚書省下諸司、州、縣，宜並用黃紙。

translations.literal: On wuwu, an edict ordered that because white paper used for edicts was often worm-eaten, henceforth all offices of the Secretariat, ministries, and prefectures and counties should uniformly use yellow paper.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu an edict ruled that white edict paper rotted too easily with worms; henceforth the Secretariat, ministries, and all prefectures and counties were to use yellow paper.

sentences.zh: 其承制敕之司，量為卷軸，以備披檢。

translations.literal: The offices that received imperial edicts were to prepare scrolls in measured quantity for ready inspection.
translations.idiomatic: Offices that received imperial orders were to keep rolled archives on hand for inspection.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，車駕還京。

translations.literal: On gengyin, the imperial carriage returned to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin the Emperor returned to Chang'an.

sentences.zh: 夏四月戊申，至自東都。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, on wushen, he arrived from the Eastern Capital.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth summer month, on wushen, he arrived from the Eastern Capital.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，中書侍郎李義琰同中書門下三品。

translations.literal: On jiayin, Secretariat Vice Director Li Yiyan became third-grade co-equal with Secretariat and Chancellery.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin Li Yiyan, vice director of the Secretariat, joined the chief ministers of the third grade.

sentences.zh: 戊午，幸九成宮。

translations.literal: On wuwu, he visited Jiucheng Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu he went to Jiucheng Palace.

sentences.zh: 六月癸丑，黃門侍郎高智周同中書門下三品。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on guichou, Yellow Gate Vice Director Gao Zhizhou became third-grade co-equal with Secretariat and Chancellery.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on guichou, Gao Zhizhou, vice director of the Chancellery, joined the chief ministers.

sentences.zh: 秋七月，彗起東井，指北河，漸東北，長三丈，掃中臺，指文昌宮，五十八日方滅。

translations.literal: In the seventh autumn month, a comet rose in the Eastern Well, pointing at the North River, gradually northeast, three zhang in length, sweeping the Central Terrace, pointing at the Wenchang Palace; after fifty-eight days it was extinguished.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month a comet rose in the Eastern Well, swept toward the North River and the northeast for three zhang, crossed the Central Terrace toward the Wenchang Palace, and vanished after fifty-eight days.

sentences.zh: 八月乙未，吐蕃寇疊州。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, on yiwei, Tibet invaded Die Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on yiwei, Tibet raided Die Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 庚子，以星變，避殿，減膳，放京城系囚，令文武官各上封事言得失。

translations.literal: On gengzi, because of the celestial anomaly, he avoided the main hall, reduced meals, released capital prisoners, and ordered civil and military officials each to submit sealed memorials on gains and losses.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi, troubled by the omen, he left the main hall, cut his table, freed the capital's prisoners, and called on every official to submit sealed advice on the state's failings.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，置南選使，簡補廣、交、黔等州官吏。

translations.literal: On renyin, southern selection envoys were established to examine and appoint officials of Guang, Jiao, Qian, and other prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin the court created southern selection envoys to review and fill posts in Guang, Jiao, Qian, and other distant prefectures.

sentences.zh: 青、齊等州海泛溢，又大雨，漂溺居人五千家，遣使賑恤之。

translations.literal: In Qing, Qi, and other prefectures the sea overflowed, and again great rain; five thousand households of drowned residents — envoys were sent to relieve and comfort them.
translations.idiomatic: Seas flooded Qing and Qi and other prefectures, and heavy rains drowned five thousand households; the court sent envoys with relief.

sentences.zh: 九月甲子朔，車駕還京。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on jiazi new moon, the imperial carriage returned to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiazi new moon of the ninth month the Emperor returned to Chang'an.

sentences.zh: 丙申，郇王素節削戶三分之二，於袁州安置。

translations.literal: On bingshen, Prince Su Jie of E had two-thirds of his household registers struck off and was settled at Yuan Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen Prince Su Jie of E lost two-thirds of his household quota and was exiled to Yuan Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，於北京置金鄰州。

translations.literal: On guichou, Jinlin Prefecture was established at the northern capital.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou the court established Jinlin Prefecture at the northern capital.

sentences.zh: 十一月丁卯，敕新造《上元舞》，圓丘、方澤、享太廟用之，餘祭則停。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, on dingmao, an edict ordered the newly composed Shangyuan Dance to be used at the round and square altars and in offerings to the Imperial Ancestral Temple; for other sacrifices it was stopped.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on dingmao, an edict prescribed the new Shangyuan Dance for the round and square altars and the ancestral temple, but not for lesser rites.

sentences.zh: 壬申，以陳州言鳳凰見於宛丘，改上元三年曰儀鳳元年，大赦。

translations.literal: On renshen, because Chen Prefecture reported a phoenix seen at Wanqiu, the third year of Shangyuan was changed to the first year of Yifeng; great amnesty.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen, after Chen Prefecture reported a phoenix at Wanqiu, the court renamed the third year of Shangyuan the first year of Yifeng and proclaimed a general amnesty.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，吏部尚書李敬玄為中書令。

translations.literal: On gengyin, Ministry of Personnel Director Li Jingxuan became Secretariat Director.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin Li Jingxuan was appointed director of the Secretariat.
