sentences.zh: 十二月丙申，皇太子賢上所注《後漢書》，賜物三萬段。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on bingshen, Crown Prince Xian presented his annotated Later Han History; thirty thousand bolts of goods were bestowed.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on bingshen, Crown Prince Xian presented his commentary on the Later Han History and received thirty thousand bolts of gifts.

sentences.zh: 戊午，遣使分道巡撫：宰相來恆河南道，薛元超河北道，左丞崔知悌等江南道。

translations.literal: On wuwu, envoys were dispatched to tour and comfort by separate routes: Chancellor Lai Heng the Henan circuit, Xue Yuanchao the Hebei circuit, Left Vice Director Cui Zhiti and others the Jiangnan circuit.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu the court sent touring commissioners: Lai Heng to Henan, Xue Yuanchao to Hebei, and Cui Zhiti and others to Jiangnan.

sentences.zh: 儀鳳二年二年春正月乙亥，上躬籍田於東郊。

translations.literal: In the second year of Yifeng, spring first month, on yihai, the Emperor personally plowed the sacred field at the eastern suburb.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Yifeng, on yihai of the first spring month, the Emperor performed the plowing rite east of the capital.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，京師地震。

translations.literal: On gengchen, the capital had an earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen an earthquake struck the capital.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，幸司竹園，即日還宮。

translations.literal: On renchen, he visited Sizhu Garden; that day he returned to the palace.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen he visited Sizhu Garden and returned to the palace the same day.

sentences.zh: 二月丁巳，工部尚書高藏授遼東都督，封朝鮮郡王，遣歸安東府，安輯高麗餘眾；

translations.literal: In the second month, on dingsi, Minister of Works Gao Zang was appointed Liaodong governor, enfeoffed as Prince of Korea, sent back to the Andong headquarters to settle the remaining Goguryeo people;
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi of the second month Gao Zang, minister of works, was made governor of Liaodong and Prince of Korea and sent back to Andong to pacify the remaining Goguryeo people;

sentences.zh: 司農卿扶餘隆熊津州都督，封帶方郡王，令往安輯百濟餘眾。

translations.literal: Minister of Agriculture Fuyu Long was made Xiongjin Prefecture governor, enfeoffed as Prince of Daifang, ordered to go settle the remaining Baekje people.
translations.idiomatic: Fuyu Long, minister of agriculture, was made governor of Xiongjin and Prince of Daifang and sent to pacify the remaining Baekje people.

sentences.zh: 仍移安東都護府於新城以統之。

translations.literal: The Andong Protectorate was again moved to Xincheng to command them.
translations.idiomatic: The Andong Protectorate was moved again to Xincheng to oversee them both.

sentences.zh: 夏四月，以河南、河北旱，遣使賑給。

translations.literal: In the fourth summer month, because Henan and Hebei suffered drought, envoys were sent to relieve and grant.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month drought struck Henan and Hebei, and the court sent relief commissioners.

sentences.zh: 八月，徙封周王顯為英王，改名哲。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, enfeoffment of Prince Xian of Zhou was changed to Prince of Ying; his name was changed to Zhe.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month Prince Xian of Zhou was retitled Prince of Ying and renamed Zhe.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，太白犯軒轅。

translations.literal: On yisi, the Great White Star intruded into Xuanyuan.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi Venus crossed the Xuanyuan asterism.

sentences.zh: 十二月乙卯，敕關內、河東諸州召募勇敢，以討吐蕃。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on yimao, an edict ordered Guannei and Hedong prefectures to recruit the brave to attack Tibet.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on yimao, an edict called on Guannei and Hedong to recruit bold men for the Tibetan campaign.

sentences.zh: 詔京文武職事官三品已上，每年各舉文武才能堪任將帥牧守者一人。

translations.literal: An edict ordered capital civil and military officials of third grade and above each year to recommend one person of civil and military talent fit to be general, governor, or prefect.
translations.idiomatic: Another edict required every capital official of the third rank or higher to nominate one man each year fit for command or provincial office.

sentences.zh: 是冬無雪。

translations.literal: That winter there was no snow.
translations.idiomatic: That winter brought no snow.

sentences.zh: 儀鳳三年三年四月丁亥朔，以旱，避正殿，親錄囚徒，悉原之。

translations.literal: In the third year of Yifeng, fourth month, on dinghai new moon, because of drought he avoided the main hall, personally recorded prisoners, and pardoned them all.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year of Yifeng, on the dinghai new moon of the fourth month, drought drove him from the main hall; he personally reviewed the prisoners and freed them all.

sentences.zh: 戊申，大赦，改來年正月一日為通乾。

translations.literal: On wushen, great amnesty; the first day of the first month of the coming year was changed to Tongqian.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen the court proclaimed a general amnesty and renamed the coming New Year's day Tongqian.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，涇州獻二小兒，連心異體，年四歲。

translations.literal: On guichou, Jing Prefecture presented two small children, conjoined at the heart with separate bodies, four years old.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou Jing Prefecture presented twin boys, four years old, joined at the heart with separate bodies.

sentences.zh: 五月壬戌，幸九成宮。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on renxu, he visited Jiucheng Palace.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on renxu, he went to Jiucheng Palace.

sentences.zh: 以相王輪為洛州牧。

translations.literal: Prince Lun of Xiang was made Luozhou governor.
translations.idiomatic: Prince Lun of Xiang was appointed governor of Luozhou.

sentences.zh: 秋七月丁巳，宴近臣諸親於咸亨殿。

translations.literal: In the seventh autumn month, on dingsi, he feasted close ministers and various kin at Xianheng Hall.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month, on dingsi, he gave a feast for close ministers and kinsmen in Xianheng Hall.

sentences.zh: 上謂霍王元軌曰：「去冬無雪，今春少雨，自避暑此宮，甘雨頻降，夏麥豐熟，秋稼滋榮。

translations.literal: The Emperor said to Prince Yuangui of Huo: "Last winter there was no snow; this spring little rain. Since I came to escape the heat at this palace, sweet rains have fallen in succession, summer wheat has ripened richly, and autumn crops flourish.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor said to Prince Yuangui of Huo: "Last winter brought no snow, and this spring scarce rain. Yet since I withdrew to this palace for the heat, gentle rains have come again and again, summer wheat stands heavy in the ear, and the autumn fields grow lush.

sentences.zh: 又得敬玄表奏，吐蕃入龍支，張虔勖與之戰，一日兩陣，斬馘極多。

translations.literal: I have also received Jingxuan's memorial reporting that Tibet entered Longzhi; Zhang Qianxu fought them, two battles in one day, beheading and capturing in extreme number.
translations.idiomatic: I have Jingxuan's report as well: Tibet crossed into Longzhi, and Zhang Qianxu met them twice in a single day, taking heads beyond count.

sentences.zh: 又太史奏，七月朔，太陽合虧而不虧。

translations.literal: Again the Grand Astrologer reported that on the first of the seventh month the sun should have suffered eclipse but did not.
translations.idiomatic: The Grand Astrologer also tells me that at the seventh-month new moon the sun should have been eclipsed, yet the sky spared it.

sentences.zh: 此蓋上天垂祐，宗社降靈，豈虛薄所能致此！

translations.literal: This is surely Heaven bending down its protection, the altars of state sending down numen — how could my slight virtue bring this about!"
translations.idiomatic: Surely Heaven bends its favor upon us and the ancestral altars breathe their blessing — no meager virtue of mine could earn such grace!"

sentences.zh: 又男輪最小，特所留愛，比來與選新婦，多不稱情；

translations.literal: "Also my son Lun is youngest and especially beloved; lately in choosing a new wife for him, many did not suit his heart;
translations.idiomatic: "Lun is my youngest boy and the one I keep closest; we have sought a bride for him again and again, yet few pleased him.

sentences.zh: 近納劉延景女，觀其極有孝行，復是私衷一喜。

translations.literal: recently he took the daughter of Liu Yanjing; seeing her extreme filial conduct, this is again a private joy in my heart.
translations.idiomatic: He has lately taken Liu Yanjing's daughter, and in her deep filial bearing I have found a private joy.

sentences.zh: 思與叔等同為此歡，各宜盡醉。

translations.literal: I wish to share this joy with you uncles alike; each of you should drink to the full."
translations.idiomatic: I would have my uncles share this gladness with me — tonight, let every cup be drained."

sentences.zh: 」上因賦七言詩效柏梁體，侍臣並和。

translations.literal: The Emperor thereupon composed a heptasyllabic poem in the Baliang style, and the attendant ministers harmonized in turn.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor then improvised a heptasyllabic poem in the Baliang manner, and each minister answered in turn.

sentences.zh: 九月丁巳，還京師。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on dingsi, he returned to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on dingsi, he returned to Chang'an.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，至自九成宮。

translations.literal: On xinyou, he arrived from Jiucheng Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou he came back from Jiucheng Palace.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，侍中張文瓘卒。

translations.literal: On bingyin, Palace Attendant Zhang Wenqian died.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin Zhang Wenqian, palace attendant, died.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，洮河道行軍大總管中書令李敬玄、左衛大將軍劉審禮等與吐蕃戰於青海之上，王師敗績，審禮被俘。

translations.literal: On bingyin, Taozhou-route campaigning grand general Secretariat Director Li Jingxuan, Left Guard Grand General Liu Shenli, and others fought Tibet on the Qinghai; the royal army was defeated, and Shenli was captured.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin Li Jingxuan, director of the Secretariat and commander of the Taozhou expedition, and Liu Shenli, grand general of the Left Guards, met Tibet on the Qinghai and were routed; Shenli was taken prisoner.

sentences.zh: 上以蕃寇為患，問計於侍臣中書舍人郭正一等，咸以備邊不深討為上策。

translations.literal: Because Tibetan raids were a worry, the Emperor asked the attendant ministers and Secretariat Drafting Officer Guo Zhengyi and others for plans; all held that deep defense on the frontier without eager pursuit was the superior policy.
translations.idiomatic: Troubled by Tibetan raids, the Emperor asked his ministers and Guo Zhengyi of the Secretariat drafting office for counsel; all urged strong border defense rather than reckless pursuit.

sentences.zh: 十月丙午，徐州刺史、密王元曉薨。

translations.literal: In the tenth month, on bingwu, Xuzhou prefect Prince Yuanxiao of Mi died.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month, on bingwu, Prince Yuanxiao of Mi, prefect of Xuzhou, died.

sentences.zh: 閏十月戊寅，熒惑犯鉤鈐。

translations.literal: Intercalary tenth month, on wuyin, Mars intruded into Gouchen.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin of the intercalary tenth month Mars crossed Gouchen.

sentences.zh: 十一月乙未，昏霧四塞，連夜不解。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, on yiwei, murky fog closed in on four sides and did not lift all night.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on yiwei, thick fog walled the horizon and did not lift all night.

sentences.zh: 丙申，雨木冰。

translations.literal: On bingshen, rain froze on the trees.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen glaze ice sheathed the trees.

sentences.zh: 壬子，黃門侍郎、同中書門下三品來恆卒。

translations.literal: On renzi, Yellow Gate Vice Director, third-grade co-equal with Secretariat and Chancellery Lai Heng died.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi Lai Heng, vice director of the Chancellery and chief minister, died.

sentences.zh: 十二月，詔停明年「通乾」之號，以反語不善故也。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, an edict stopped the coming year's era name Tongqian, because the reversed phrasing was ill-omened.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month an edict canceled the Tongqian era name for the coming year, since read backward its words were unlucky.

sentences.zh: 調露元年四年正月辛未，戶部尚書、平恩縣公許圉師卒。

translations.literal: In the first year of Tiaolu, first month, on xinwei, Minister of Revenue, Duke of Ping'en Xu Yuanshi died.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Tiaolu, on xinwei of the first month, Xu Yuanshi, Duke of Ping'en and minister of revenue, died.

sentences.zh: 己酉，幸東都。

translations.literal: On jiyou, he visited the Eastern Capital.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou he went to the Eastern Capital.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，尚書右僕射、道國公戴至德薨。

translations.literal: On gengxu, Dai Zhide, Right Vice Director of the Secretariat and Duke of Daoguo, died.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu, Dai Zhide, right vice director of the secretariat and Duke of Daoguo, died.

sentences.zh: 二月壬戌，吐蕃贊普卒，遣使吊祭之。

translations.literal: Second month, renxu: the Tufan zanpu died; envoys were sent to mourn him.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on renxu, the Tibetan king died; the court sent envoys to mourn him.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，東都饑，官出糙米以救饑人。

translations.literal: On yichou, famine struck the eastern capital; the government issued husked rice to feed the hungry.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou, with famine in the eastern capital, officials issued husked rice to the starving.

sentences.zh: 夏四月戊午，熒惑入羽林星。

translations.literal: Fourth month, summer, wuwu: Mars entered the Feathered Forest constellation.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu in the fourth summer month, Mars entered the Feathered Forest.

sentences.zh: 左丞崔知悌為戶部尚書，中書令郝處俊為侍中。

translations.literal: Left Assistant Cui Zhiti became Minister of Revenue; Palace Secretariat Director Hao Chujun became Palace Attendant.
translations.idiomatic: Left assistant Cui Zhiti became minister of revenue; secretariat director Hao Chujun became palace attendant.

sentences.zh: 五月壬午，盜殺正諫大夫明崇儼。

translations.literal: Fifth month, renwu: the Remonstrator of the Left Ming Chongyan was murdered by bandits.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu in the fifth month, bandits killed left remonstrator Ming Chongyan.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，皇太子賢監國。

translations.literal: On bingxu the crown prince Xian acted as regent.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu Crown Prince Xian took up regency.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，造紫桂宮於沔池之西。

translations.literal: On wuxu the Purple Cassia Palace was built west of Mian Pool.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu he built Purple Cassia Palace west of Mian Pool.

sentences.zh: 六月辛亥，制大赦天下，改儀鳳四年為調露元年。

translations.literal: Sixth month, xinhai: a great amnesty was proclaimed for all under Heaven; the fourth year of Yifeng was changed to the first year of Tiaolu.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai in the sixth month he proclaimed a general amnesty and renamed Yifeng 4 as Tiaolu 1.

sentences.zh: 秋七月己卯朔，詔以今年冬至有事嵩岳，禮官學士詳定儀注。

translations.literal: Seventh month, autumn, on the yimao new moon: an edict ordered the winter solstice of this year to hold rites at Mount Song; ritual officers and academicians were to fix the protocol in detail.
translations.idiomatic: On the yimao new moon of the seventh autumn month he decreed winter solstice rites at Mount Song and told ritual officers and scholars to draft the protocol.

sentences.zh: 八月丁巳，侍中郝處俊、左庶子高智周、黃門侍郎崔知溫、給事中劉景先兼修國史。

translations.literal: Eighth month, dingsi: Palace Attendant Hao Chujun, Left Heir-Apparent Tutor Gao Zhizhou, Vice Director of the Secretariat Cui Zhiwen, and Drafting Attendant Liu Jingxian were additionally ordered to compile the national history.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi in the eighth month, Hao Chujun, Gao Zhizhou, Cui Zhiwen, and Liu Jingxian were also assigned to compile the national history.

sentences.zh: 九月壬午，吏部侍郎裴行儉討西突厥，擒其十姓可汗阿史那都支及別帥李遮匐以歸。

translations.literal: Ninth month, renwu: Vice Director of the Ministry of Personnel Pei Xingjian campaigned against the Western Turks and brought back the ten-clan qaghan Ashina Duzhi and the subordinate chief Li Zhebi.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu in the ninth month, vice minister Pei Xingjian defeated the Western Turks and returned with qaghan Ashina Duzhi of the ten clans and subordinate chief Li Zhebi.

sentences.zh: 冬十月，單于大都護府突厥阿史德溫傅及奉職二部相率反叛，立阿史那泥熟匐為可汗，二十四州首領並叛。

translations.literal: Tenth month, winter: Wen Fu of the Ashide clan and Fengzhi of the two tribes under the Protectorate General of the Pacified North rebelled together, enthroning Ashina Nishufu as qaghan; chieftains of twenty-four prefectures all rose.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth winter month, Ashide Wen Fu and Fengzhi rebelled in the pacified north, set up Ashina Nishufu as qaghan, and twenty-four prefectural chiefs joined them.

sentences.zh: 遣單于大都護長史蕭嗣業，將軍花大智、李景嘉等討之。

translations.literal: Chief Secretary of the Protectorate Xiao Siye and Generals Hua Dazhi and Li Jingjia were sent to attack them.
translations.idiomatic: Chief secretary Xiao Siye and generals Hua Dazhi and Li Jingjia were dispatched against them.

sentences.zh: 與突厥戰，為賊所敗。

translations.literal: They fought the Turks and were defeated by the rebels.
translations.idiomatic: In battle with the Turks they were beaten.

sentences.zh: 嗣業配流桂州。

translations.literal: Siye was banished to Guizhou.
translations.idiomatic: Siye was exiled to Guizhou.

sentences.zh: 壬子，令將軍曹懷舜率兵往恆州守井陘，崔獻往絳州守龍門，以備突厥。

translations.literal: On renzi Generals Cao Huai-shun and Cui Xian were ordered to hold Hengzhou at Jingxing and Jiangzhou at Longmen against the Turks.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi he sent Cao Huai-shun to guard Jingxing at Hengzhou and Cui Xian Longmen at Jiangzhou against the Turks.

sentences.zh: 庚申，前詔封嵩山，宜停。

translations.literal: On gengshen the earlier edict for fengshan at Mount Song was halted.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen he suspended the planned fengshan at Mount Song.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，吐蕃文成公主遣其大臣論塞調傍來告喪，請和親，不許。

translations.literal: On guihai Princess Wencheng of Tufan sent her minister Lun Sai-diao-pang to announce mourning and request a marriage alliance; it was refused.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai Tibetan envoys came mourning Princess Wencheng and seeking a marriage alliance; the court refused.

sentences.zh: 遣郎將宋令文使吐蕃，會贊普之葬。

translations.literal: Commandant Song Lingwen was sent to Tufan to attend the zanpu's funeral.
translations.idiomatic: Commandant Song Lingwen was sent to Tibet for the king's funeral.

sentences.zh: 十一月戊寅朔，左庶子、同三品高智周罷知政事。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, on the wuyin new moon: Left Heir-Apparent Tutor and Same Rank as the Three Offices Gao Zhizhou left confidential counsel.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuyin new moon of the eleventh month, Gao Zhizhou, left heir tutor and third rank, left confidential counsel.

sentences.zh: 癸未，以吏部侍郎裴行儉為禮部尚書，賞擒都支、遮匐之功也。

translations.literal: On guiwei Vice Director of Personnel Pei Xingjian was made Minister of Rites, rewarding the capture of Duzhi and Zhebi.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei Pei Xingjian became minister of rites, rewarded for capturing Duzhi and Zhebi.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，裴行儉為定襄道大總管，與營州都督周道務等兵十八萬，並西軍程務挺、東軍李文暕等，總三十萬以討突厥。

translations.literal: On jiachen Pei Xingjian became Grand General of the Dingxiang Circuit with one hundred eighty thousand men under Yingzhou Governor Zhou Daowu, together with Western Army Cheng Wuting and Eastern Army Li Wenhan—three hundred thousand in all—to campaign against the Turks.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen Pei Xingjian took the Dingxiang command with one hundred eighty thousand men, joined by Cheng Wuting in the west and Li Wenhan in the east—three hundred thousand in all—to crush the Turks.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，臨軒試應岳牧舉人。

translations.literal: On jiayin he held the palace examination for candidates nominated by prefects and governors.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin he examined at the palace candidates put forward by prefects and governors.

sentences.zh: 永隆元年二年春正月乙酉，宴諸王、諸司三品已上、諸州都督刺史於洛城南門樓，奏新造《六合還淳》之舞。

translations.literal: First year of Yonglong, second year, spring, first month, yiyou: he feasted princes, all offices of third rank and above, and prefectural governors at the south gate tower of Luoyang and had the newly composed dance "Six Harmonies Return to Purity" performed.
translations.idiomatic: Yonglong 2, on yiyou of the first spring month, he feasted princes, third-rank officials, and governors at Luoyang's south gate and watched the new dance "Six Harmonies Return to Purity."

sentences.zh: 二月丙午，詔曰：「故符璽郎李延壽撰《正典》一部，辭殫雅正，雖已淪亡，功猶可錄，宜賜其家絹五十疋。

translations.literal: Second month, bingwu, edict: "Former Seal Clerk Li Yanshou compiled one work, the Correct Canon; the language exhausts elegance and rectitude. Though it is lost, the merit may still be recorded—fifty bolts of silk should be granted to his household."
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu in the second month he decreed: "The late seal clerk Li Yanshou's Correct Canon, though lost, was written in refined language; grant his family fifty bolts of silk."

sentences.zh: 」壬子，霍王元軌率文武百僚，請出一月俸料助軍，以討突厥。

translations.literal: On renzi Prince Huo Yuan Gui led civil and military officials of every rank to offer one month's salary to aid the army campaigning against the Turks.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi Prince Huo Yuan Gui and the hundred officials offered one month's pay to support the anti-Turk campaign.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，幸汝州溫湯。

translations.literal: On guichou he visited the hot springs of Ruzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou he went to the hot springs at Ruzhou.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，至少室山。

translations.literal: On dingsi he arrived at Mount Shaoshi.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi he reached Mount Shaoshi.

sentences.zh: 戊午，親謁少姨廟。

translations.literal: On wuwu he personally sacrificed at the Shrine of the Young Consort.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu he sacrificed in person at the Young Consort Shrine.

sentences.zh: 賜故玉清觀道士王遠知謚曰升真先生，贈太中大夫。

translations.literal: The late Daoist of Yujing Abbey Wang Yuanzhi was posthumously titled True Gentleman of Ascension and given the late rank of Grand Master for Palace Counsel.
translations.idiomatic: The late Daoist Wang Yuanzhi of Yujing Abbey was posthumously styled True Gentleman of Ascension and made grand master for palace counsel.

sentences.zh: 又幸隱士田游巖所居。

translations.literal: He also visited the dwelling of the recluse Tian Youyan.
translations.idiomatic: He also called on the recluse Tian Youyan.

sentences.zh: 己未，幸嵩陽觀及啟母廟，並命立碑。

translations.literal: On jiwei he visited Songyang Abbey and the Shrine of Qimu and ordered steles erected at both.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei he visited Songyang Abbey and the Qimu Shrine and ordered monuments raised.

sentences.zh: 又幸逍遙谷道士潘師正所居。

translations.literal: He also visited the dwelling of the wandering Daoist Pan Shizheng at Carefree Valley.
translations.idiomatic: He also visited the Daoist Pan Shizheng at Carefree Valley.

sentences.zh: 甲子，自溫湯還東都。

translations.literal: On jiazi he returned from the hot springs to the eastern capital.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi he came back from the hot springs to the eastern capital.

sentences.zh: 三月，裴行儉大破突厥於黑山，擒其首領奉職。

translations.literal: Third month: Pei Xingjian routed the Turks at Black Mountain and captured their leader Fengzhi.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month Pei Xingjian smashed the Turks at Black Mountain and took their leader Fengzhi.

sentences.zh: 偽可汗泥熟匐為其部下所殺，傳首來降。

translations.literal: The false qaghan Nishufu was killed by his own men; his head was sent in surrender.
translations.idiomatic: The puppet qaghan Nishufu was killed by his followers and his head sent in.

sentences.zh: 夏四月乙丑，幸紫桂宮。

translations.literal: Fourth month, summer, yichou: he visited Purple Cassia Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou in the fourth summer month he went to Purple Cassia Palace.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，黃門侍郎裴炎崔知溫、中書侍郎王德真並同中書門下三品。

translations.literal: On wuchen Vice Directors Pei Yan and Cui Zhiwen and Secretariat Vice Director Wang Dezhen were all made Fellows of the Secretariat-Chancellery of the Third Rank.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen Pei Yan, Cui Zhiwen, and Wang Dezhen all became third-rank fellows of the secretariat-chancellery.

sentences.zh: 五月癸未，熒惑犯輿鬼。

translations.literal: Fifth month, guiwei: Mars trespassed against the Ghost constellation.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei in the fifth month Mars crossed the Ghost Lodge.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，太白經天。

translations.literal: On dingyou the Great White star crossed the sky.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou Venus crossed the heavens.

sentences.zh: 秋七月，吐蕃寇河源，屯於良非川。

translations.literal: Seventh month, autumn: Tufan raided Heyuan and encamped on the Liangfei River.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh autumn month Tibet raided Heyuan and camped on the Liangfei River.

sentences.zh: 河西鎮撫大使李敬玄與吐蕃將贊婆戰於湟中，官軍敗績。

translations.literal: Pacification Commissioner of Hexi Li Jingxuan fought the Tufan general Zanpo in Huangzhong; the government army was defeated.
translations.idiomatic: Li Jingxuan, pacification commissioner of Hexi, fought the Tibetan general Zanpo at Huangzhong and was beaten.

sentences.zh: 時左武衛將軍黑齒常之力戰，大破蕃軍，遂擢為河源軍經略大使；

translations.literal: At the time Left Martial Guard General Heichi Changzhi fought fiercely and routed the barbarian army; he was promoted to Commissioner of the Heyuan Army;
translations.idiomatic: Left guard general Heichi Changzhi fought hard, routed the Tibetans, and was made commissioner of the Heyuan army;

sentences.zh: 令李敬玄鎮鄯州，為之援。

translations.literal: Li Jingxuan was ordered to hold Qinzhou in support.
translations.idiomatic: while Li Jingxuan held Qinzhou to back him.

sentences.zh: 丙申，江王元祥薨。

translations.literal: On bingshen Prince Jiang Yuan Xiang died.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen Prince Jiang of Jiang died.

sentences.zh: 是月，突厥餘眾圍雲州，中郎將程務挺擊破之。

translations.literal: That month the Turk remnant besieged Yunzhou; Commandant Cheng Wuting broke them.
translations.idiomatic: That month Turk remnants besieged Yunzhou; commandant Cheng Wuting drove them off.

sentences.zh: 八月丁未，自紫桂宮還東都。

translations.literal: Eighth month, dingwei: he returned from Purple Cassia Palace to the eastern capital.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei in the eighth month he returned from Purple Cassia Palace to the eastern capital.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，鄯州都督李敬玄左遷衡州刺史。

translations.literal: On dingsi Qinzhou Governor Li Jingxuan was demoted to prefect of Hengzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi Li Jingxuan, governor of Qinzhou, was demoted to prefect of Heng.

sentences.zh: 甲子，廢皇太子賢為庶人，幽於別所。

translations.literal: On jiazi the crown prince Xian was deposed as commoner and confined in a separate dwelling.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi Crown Prince Xian was deposed to commoner rank and shut away.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，立英王哲為皇太子。

translations.literal: On yichou Prince Ying Zhe was installed as crown prince.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou Prince Ying Zhe was made crown prince.

sentences.zh: 改調露二年為永隆元年，赦天下，大酺三日。

translations.literal: The second year of Tiaolu was changed to the first year of Yonglong; all under Heaven was pardoned and great feasting lasted three days.
translations.idiomatic: Tiaolu 2 became Yonglong 1; he pardoned the realm and held three days of public feasting.

sentences.zh: 太子左庶子、同中書門下三品張大安坐庶人左遷普州刺史。

translations.literal: Left Heir-Apparent Tutor and Fellow of the Secretariat-Chancellery Zhang Da'an, implicated with the deposed man, was demoted to prefect of Pu.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Da'an, left heir tutor and chancellery fellow, was demoted to Pu for ties to the deposed prince.

sentences.zh: 九月，河南、河北諸州大水，遣使賑恤，溺死者官給棺槥，其家賜物七段。

translations.literal: Ninth month: great floods in Henan and Hebei; envoys were sent to relieve distress; the drowned were given coffins by the state and their families seven lengths of goods.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month floods ravaged Henan and Hebei; envoys brought relief, state coffins for the drowned, and seven lengths of goods to each family.

sentences.zh: 冬十月壬寅，蘇州刺史曹王明封零陵郡王，於黔州安置，坐附庶人賢也。

translations.literal: Tenth month, winter, renyin: Cao Wang Ming of Suzhou was enfeoffed Prince of Lingling and settled at Qianzhou for adhering to the deposed Xian.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin in the tenth winter month Prince Cao Ming of Suzhou was made Prince of Lingling and sent to Qianzhou for siding with the deposed prince.

sentences.zh: 己酉，自東都還京。

translations.literal: On jiwei he returned from the eastern capital to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei he came back from the eastern capital to Chang'an.

sentences.zh: 十一月朔，日有蝕之。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, new moon: there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: On the eleventh-month new moon the sun was eclipsed.

sentences.zh: 洛州饑，減價官糶，以救饑人。

translations.literal: Famine in Luozhou; the government sold grain at reduced price to feed the hungry.
translations.idiomatic: Luozhou starved; officials sold grain cheap to feed the people.

sentences.zh: 開耀元年二年春正月，突厥寇原、慶等州。

translations.literal: First year of Kaiyao, second year, spring, first month: the Turks raided Yuan and Qing prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: Kaiyao 2, first spring month: Turks raided Yuan and Qing.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，命將軍李知十、王杲等分兵御之。

translations.literal: On yihai Generals Li Zhishi and Wang Gao were ordered to meet them with divided forces.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai he sent Li Zhishi and Wang Gao against them with separate columns.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，遣禮部尚書裴行儉為定襄道大總管，率師討突厥溫傅部落。

translations.literal: On guisi Minister of Rites Pei Xingjian was made Grand General of the Dingxiang Circuit to lead troops against the Turk Wen Fu tribe.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi Pei Xingjian took the Dingxiang command to campaign against the Turk Wen Fu.

sentences.zh: 己亥，詔雍、岐、華、同民戶宜免兩年地稅，河南、河北遭水處一年。

translations.literal: On jihai an edict exempted households of Yong, Qi, Hua, and Tong from land tax for two years, and those in flood-struck Henan and Hebei for one.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai he exempted Yong, Qi, Hua, and Tong from land tax for two years and flood-hit Henan and Hebei for one.

sentences.zh: 上詔雍州長史李義玄曰：「朕思還淳返樸，示天下以質素。

translations.literal: He addressed Yongzhou Governor Li Yixuan: "I wish to return to purity and show the realm plain substance."
translations.idiomatic: He told Yongzhou governor Li Yixuan: "I mean to return the realm to plain ways and show it simplicity."

sentences.zh: 如聞游手墮業，此類極多，時稍不豐，便致饑饉。

translations.literal: I hear idlers abandon their trades—such people are very many; when harvests fail slightly, famine follows.
translations.idiomatic: I hear too many leave honest work; a thin harvest brings hunger.

sentences.zh: 其異色綾錦，並花間裙衣等，糜費既廣，俱害女工。

translations.literal: Variegated silks and flowered skirts and coats waste much and harm women's labor.
translations.idiomatic: Bright silks and flowered skirts waste cloth and steal from women's looms.

sentences.zh: 天後，我之匹敵，常著七破間裙，豈不知更有靡麗服飾？

translations.literal: The Heavenly Empress is my equal; she often wears the seven-panel slit skirt—does she not know there are still more lavish garments?
translations.idiomatic: The empress is my match; she still wears the seven-panel skirt—surely she knows costlier dress exists?

sentences.zh: 務遵節儉也。

translations.literal: Let thrift be observed.
translations.idiomatic: See that you keep to thrift.

sentences.zh: 其紫服赤衣，閭閻公然服用。

translations.literal: Purple robes and red garments are openly worn in the lanes.
translations.idiomatic: Purple and scarlet are worn openly in the streets.

sentences.zh: 兼商賈富人，厚葬越禮。

translations.literal: Rich merchants too bury their dead beyond ritual.
translations.idiomatic: Merchants and the rich bury beyond what rites allow.

sentences.zh: 卿可嚴加捉搦，勿使更然。

translations.literal: You must seize them strictly and not let it happen again.
translations.idiomatic: Seize offenders strictly and stop this.

translations.literal: Thus ended the edict.
translations.idiomatic: With that the edict closed.

sentences.zh: 二月丙午，皇太子親行釋奠禮。

translations.literal: Second month, bingwu: the crown prince personally performed the libation-and-offering rite.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu in the second month the crown prince performed the libation rite in person.

sentences.zh: 三月辛卯，左僕射、同三品劉仁軌兼太子少傅。

translations.literal: Third month, xinmao: Left Vice Director and Same Rank as the Three Offices Liu Ren'gui was additionally made Junior Tutor of the Heir Apparent.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao Liu Ren'gui, left vice director and third rank, was also made junior tutor to the heir.

sentences.zh: 侍中郝處俊為太子少保，罷知政事。

translations.literal: Palace Attendant Hao Chujun became Junior Tutor of the Heir Apparent and left confidential counsel.
translations.idiomatic: Hao Chujun became junior heir tutor and left confidential counsel.

sentences.zh: 五月丙戌，定襄道總管曹懷舜與突厥史伏念戰於橫水，官軍大敗。

translations.literal: Fifth month, bingxu: Dingxiang Circuit Commander Cao Huai-shun fought the Turk Shi Funian at Hengshui; the government army was routed.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu in the fifth month Cao Huai-shun fought the Turk Shi Funian at Hengshui and was crushed.

sentences.zh: 懷舜減死，配流嶺南。

translations.literal: Huai-shun's sentence was reduced from death; he was banished to Lingnan.
translations.idiomatic: Huai-shun was spared death and exiled to Lingnan.

sentences.zh: 六月壬子，故江王元祥男晫以犯名教，斬於大理寺後園。

translations.literal: Sixth month, renzi: Zhao, son of the late Prince Jiang Yuan Xiang, was beheaded in the rear garden of the Court of Judicial Review for violating name-and-teaching.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi in the sixth month Zhao, son of the late Prince Jiang, was beheaded behind the review court for violating moral law.

sentences.zh: 七月，太平公主出降薛紹，赦京城系囚。

translations.literal: Seventh month: Princess Taiping married Xue Shao; prisoners in the capital were pardoned.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month Princess Taiping wed Xue Shao and capital prisoners were freed.

sentences.zh: 閏七月丁未，黃門侍郎裴炎為侍中，黃門侍郎崔知溫、中書侍郎薛元超並為中書令。

translations.literal: Intercalary seventh month, dingwei: Vice Director Pei Yan became Palace Attendant; Vice Directors Cui Zhiwen and Secretariat Vice Director Xue Yuanchao became Directors of the Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei in the intercalary seventh month Pei Yan became palace attendant and Cui Zhiwen and Xue Yuanchao became secretariat directors.

sentences.zh: 庚申，上以服餌，令皇太子監國。

translations.literal: On gengshen, because of elixirs he took, he ordered the crown prince to act as regent.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen, ill from elixirs, he put the crown prince in charge.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，雍州大風害稼，米價騰踴。

translations.literal: On bingyin a great wind in Yongzhou damaged the crops and grain prices soared.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin a gale in Yong Prefecture ruined the harvest and grain prices spiked.

sentences.zh: 是月，裴行儉大破突厥史伏念之眾，伏念為程務挺急追，遂執溫傅來降，行儉於是盡平突厥餘黨。

translations.literal: That month Pei Xingjian routed the horde of the Turk Shi Funian; Funian, pressed by Cheng Wuting, seized Wen Fu and came to surrender; Xingjian then pacified all Turk remnants.
translations.idiomatic: That month Pei Xingjian shattered Shi Funian's horde; pressed by Cheng Wuting, Funian seized Wen Fu and surrendered, and Xingjian cleared the last Turks.

sentences.zh: 行儉執伏念、溫傅，振旅凱旋。

translations.literal: Xingjian brought in Funian and Wen Fu and returned in triumph.
translations.idiomatic: Xingjian brought Funian and Wen Fu home in triumph.

sentences.zh: 八月丁卯朔，河南、河北大水，許遭水處往江、淮已南就食。

translations.literal: Eighth month, on the dingmao new moon: great floods in Henan and Hebei; those in flooded areas were allowed to go south of the Yangtze and Huai to find food.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingmao new moon in the eighth month floods hit Henan and Hebei; the flooded were sent south of the Yangtze and Huai for grain.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，戶部尚書崔知悌卒。

translations.literal: On dinghai Minister of Revenue Cui Zhiti died.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai minister of revenue Cui Zhiti died.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，改交州為安南都護府。

translations.literal: On xinmao Jiaozhou was changed to the Protectorate General of Annan.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao Jiaozhou became the protectorate of Annan.

sentences.zh: 九月丙申，彗星見於天市，長五尺。

translations.literal: Ninth month, bingshen: a comet appeared in the Celestial Market, five chi long.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen in the ninth month a comet five chi long appeared in the Celestial Market.

sentences.zh: 冬十月丙寅朔，日有蝕之。

translations.literal: Tenth month, winter, on the bingyin new moon: there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingyin new moon of the tenth winter month the sun was eclipsed.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，改永隆二年為開耀元年。

translations.literal: On yichou the second year of Yonglong was changed to the first year of Kaiyao.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou Yonglong 2 became Kaiyao 1.

sentences.zh: 曲赦定襄軍及緣征突厥官吏兵募等。

translations.literal: A selective pardon was proclaimed for the Dingxiang army and officials, soldiers, and recruits along the Turk campaign.
translations.idiomatic: He issued a partial pardon for the Dingxiang army and everyone on the Turk campaign.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，斬阿史那伏念及溫傅等五十四人於都市。

translations.literal: On bingyin Ashina Funian and Wen Fu and fifty-four others were executed in the marketplace.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin Ashina Funian, Wen Fu, and fifty-four others were beheaded in the market.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，新羅王金法敏薨，仍以其子政襲位。

translations.literal: On dinghai King Kim Popsin of Silla died; his son Chong was still allowed to succeed.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai King Popsin of Silla died; his son Chong succeeded him.

sentences.zh: 十一月癸卯，徙庶人賢於巴州。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, guimao: the deposed Xian was moved to Bazhou.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao in the eleventh month the deposed Xian was sent to Ba.

sentences.zh: 十二月，吐火羅獻金衣一領，上不受。

translations.literal: Twelfth month: Tokhara presented a golden robe; the emperor did not accept it.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month Tokhara offered a gold robe; he refused it.

sentences.zh: 辛未，太子少保、甑山縣公郝處俊薨。

translations.literal: On xinwei Junior Tutor of the Heir Apparent and Duke of Zengshan Hao Chujun died.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei junior heir tutor Hao Chujun, Duke of Zengshan, died.

sentences.zh: 永淳元年永淳元年正月乙未朔，以年饑，罷朝會。

translations.literal: First year of Yongchun, on the yimao new moon of the first month, because of famine the court assembly was suspended.
translations.idiomatic: Yongchun 1, on the yimao new moon of the first month: famine halted the court assembly.

sentences.zh: 關內諸府兵，令於鄧、綏等州就穀。

translations.literal: Fubing of the interior circuits were ordered to draw grain in Deng, Sui, and other prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: Interior fubing were sent to draw rations in Deng, Sui, and other prefectures.

sentences.zh: 二月癸未，以太子誕皇孫滿月，大赦。

translations.literal: Second month, guiwei: because the crown prince's grandson had completed his first month, a great amnesty was proclaimed.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei in the second month, when the crown prince's grandson completed his first month, he proclaimed a general amnesty.

sentences.zh: 改開耀二年為永淳元年，大酺三日。

translations.literal: The second year of Kaiyao was changed to the first year of Yongchun; great public feasting lasted three days.
translations.idiomatic: Kaiyao 2 became Yongchun 1; public feasting lasted three days.

sentences.zh: 戊午，立皇孫重照為皇太孫，欲開府置僚屬。

translations.literal: On wuwu the emperor's grandson Chongzhao was installed as Imperial Grandson; he wished to open a bureau and appoint staff.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu he made his grandson Chongzhao imperial grandson and planned a bureau with staff.

sentences.zh: 吏部郎中王方慶曰：「按周禮，有嫡子無嫡孫。

translations.literal: Director of the Ministry of Personnel Wang Fangqing said: "According to the Rites of Zhou, when there is a legitimate son there is no legitimate grandson.
translations.idiomatic: Personnel director Wang Fangqing said: "The Zhou Rites hold that with a legitimate son there is no legitimate grandson.

sentences.zh: 漢、魏已來，皇太子在，不立太孫，但封王耳。

translations.literal: From Han and Wei onward, while the crown prince lived no imperial grandson was installed—only princes were enfeoffed.
translations.idiomatic: From Han and Wei on, while a crown prince lived no imperial grandson was named—only princes were enfeoffed.

sentences.zh: 晉立愍懷太子子彧為太孫，齊立文惠太子子昭業為太孫，便居東宮；

translations.literal: Jin installed Minhuai Crown Prince's son Yu as imperial grandson, and Qi installed Wenhuai Crown Prince's son Zhaoye as imperial grandson, and each dwelt in the Eastern Palace;
translations.idiomatic: Jin made Minhuai's son Yu imperial grandson and Qi made Wenhuai's son Zhaoye imperial grandson, each dwelling in the eastern palace;

sentences.zh: 而皇太子在而立太孫，未有前例。

translations.literal: yet to install an imperial grandson while the crown prince still lived has no precedent.
translations.idiomatic: but to name an imperial grandson while the crown prince still lives has no precedent."

sentences.zh: 」上曰：「自我作古，可乎？

translations.literal: The emperor said: "If I make the precedent myself, may I?"
translations.idiomatic: The emperor said: "May I make the precedent myself?"

translations.literal: He said: "You may."
translations.idiomatic: He answered: "You may."

sentences.zh: 」然竟不立府僚。

translations.literal: Yet in the end no bureau staff was appointed.
translations.idiomatic: In the end he appointed no bureau staff.

sentences.zh: 是春，關內旱，日色如赭。

translations.literal: That spring the interior suffered drought; the sun's color was like ochre.
translations.idiomatic: That spring drought struck the interior; the sun looked ochre.

sentences.zh: 四月甲子朔，日有蝕之。

translations.literal: Fourth month, on the jiazi new moon: there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiazi new moon of the fourth month the sun was eclipsed.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，幸東都。

translations.literal: On bingyin he proceeded to the eastern capital.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin he went to the eastern capital.

sentences.zh: 皇太子京師留守，命劉仁軌、裴炎、薛元超等輔之。

translations.literal: The crown prince remained at the capital as regent; Liu Ren'gui, Pei Yan, Xue Yuanchao, and others were ordered to assist him.
translations.idiomatic: The crown prince stayed in the capital; Liu Ren'gui, Pei Yan, and Xue Yuanchao were to assist him.

sentences.zh: 上以穀貴，減扈從兵，士庶從者多殍踣於路。

translations.literal: Because grain was costly he reduced the escort; many soldiers and commoners following died by the roadside.
translations.idiomatic: Grain was dear; he cut the escort, and many followers died on the road.

sentences.zh: 辛未，以裴行儉為金牙道行軍大總管，與將軍閻懷旦等三總管兵分道討十姓突厥阿史那車薄。

translations.literal: On xinwei Pei Xingjian was made Mobile Grand General of the Golden Tooth Circuit; with Generals Yan Huaidan and others the three circuit armies marched separately against the ten-clan Turk Ashina Chebo.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei Pei Xingjian became mobile commander on the Golden Tooth circuit; with Yan Huaidan and others three columns marched against the ten-clan Turk Ashina Chebo.

sentences.zh: 行儉未行而卒。

translations.literal: Xingjian died before he could set out.
translations.idiomatic: Xingjian died before he marched.

sentences.zh: 安西副都護王方翼破車薄、咽面，西域平。

translations.literal: Deputy Protector-General of Anxi Wang Fangyi defeated Chebo and Yanmian; the Western Regions were pacified.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Fangyi, deputy protector of Anxi, defeated Chebo and Yanmian and pacified the west.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，次澠池之紫桂宮。

translations.literal: On wuyin he halted at Purple Cassia Palace in Mianchi.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin he stopped at Purple Cassia Palace in Mianchi.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，至東都。

translations.literal: On yiyou he arrived at the eastern capital.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou he reached the eastern capital.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，黃門侍郎郭待舉、兵部侍郎岑長倩、中書侍郎郭正一、吏部侍郎魏玄同並同中書門下同承受進止平章事。

translations.literal: On dinghai Vice Director Guo Daiju, Vice Director of War Cen Changqian, Secretariat Vice Director Guo Zhengyi, and Vice Director of Personnel Wei Xuantong were all made Fellows of the Secretariat-Chancellery who receive and execute memorials and deliberate as Chief Ministers.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai Guo Daiju, Cen Changqian, Guo Zhengyi, and Wei Xuantong became chancellery fellows who received memorials and deliberated as chief ministers.

sentences.zh: 上謂參知政事崔知溫曰：「待舉等歷任尚淺，且令預聞政事，未可即與卿等同名稱。

translations.literal: The emperor told Participant in Governance Cui Zhiwen: "Daiju and the others have shallow experience; let them first hear state affairs—they may not yet share your title."
translations.idiomatic: He told Cui Zhiwen: "Daiju and the rest are new; let them hear affairs first—they are not yet your equals in title."

sentences.zh: 」自是外司四品已下知政事者，遂以平章為名。

translations.literal: From this, those outside the secretariat of fourth rank and below who joined governance were called "Chief Minister."
translations.idiomatic: After this, fourth-rank outsiders who joined governance were called "chief minister."

sentences.zh: 五月壬寅，置東都苑總監。

translations.literal: Fifth month, renyin: a Director of the Eastern Capital Park was established.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin in the fifth month he created a director for the eastern capital parks.

sentences.zh: 自丙午連日澍雨，洛水溢，壞天津及中橋、立德、弘教、景行諸坊，溺居民千餘家。

translations.literal: From bingwu onward rain fell day after day; the Luo River overflowed, wrecking Tianjin Bridge and the Central Bridge and the Lide, Hongjiao, Jingxing, and other wards; more than a thousand households were drowned.
translations.idiomatic: From bingwu rain fell daily; the Luo flooded, destroying Tianjin and Central bridges and the Lide, Hongjiao, and Jingxing wards—over a thousand homes drowned.

sentences.zh: 六月，關中初雨，麥苗澇損，後旱，京兆、岐、隴螟蝗食苗並盡，加以民多疫癘，死者枕藉於路，詔所在官司埋瘞。

translations.literal: Sixth month: the interior at first had rain and wheat was waterlogged; afterward came drought; in Jingzhao, Qi, and Long, locusts ate the seedlings to the root; moreover pestilence killed many—corpses lay piled on the roads; an edict ordered local offices to bury them.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month early rain ruined wheat, then drought; locusts stripped Jingzhao, Qi, and Long; plague piled corpses on the roads—offices were ordered to bury the dead.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，以岐州刺史蘇良嗣為雍州長史。

translations.literal: On dingchou Su Liangsi, prefect of Qi, was made Governor of Yong.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou Qi prefect Su Liangsi became governor of Yong.

sentences.zh: 京師人相食，寇盜縱橫。

translations.literal: In the capital people ate one another; bandits ran wild.
translations.idiomatic: In the capital men ate the dead and bandits roamed free.

sentences.zh: 秋七月己亥，造奉天宮於嵩山之陽，仍置嵩陽縣。

translations.literal: Seventh month, autumn, jihai: Fengtian Palace was built on the south slope of Mount Song; Songyang County was also established.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai in the seventh autumn month he built Fengtian Palace on Mount Song's south slope and founded Songyang County.

sentences.zh: 又於藍田造萬全宮。

translations.literal: Wanquan Palace was also built at Lantian.
translations.idiomatic: He also built Wanquan Palace at Lantian.

sentences.zh: 庚申，零陵王明薨。

translations.literal: On gengshen Prince Lingling Ming died.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen Prince Lingling Ming, exiled to Qian, died.

sentences.zh: 是秋，山東大水，民饑。

translations.literal: That autumn great floods struck Shandong; the people starved.
translations.idiomatic: That autumn Shandong flooded and the people starved.

sentences.zh: 吐蕃寇柘、松、翼等州。

translations.literal: Tufan raided Zhe, Song, and Yi prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: Tibet raided Zhe, Song, and Yi.

sentences.zh: 冬十月甲子，京師地震。

translations.literal: Tenth month, winter, jiazi: the capital was shaken by earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi in the tenth winter month the capital quaked.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，黃門侍郎劉景先同平章事。

translations.literal: On bingyin Vice Director Liu Jingxian became Chief Minister.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin vice director Liu Jingxian became chief minister.

sentences.zh: 十二月，南天竺、于闐各獻方物。

translations.literal: Twelfth month: South India and Khotan each presented tribute.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month south India and Khotan sent tribute.

sentences.zh: 突厥餘黨阿史那骨篤祿等招合殘眾，據黑沙城，入寇並州北境。

translations.literal: Turk remnant Ashina Gulolu and others gathered the scattered and held Black Sand City, raiding the north of Bingzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Turk remnant Gulolu gathered survivors at Black Sand and raided Bing's north.

sentences.zh: 弘道元年二年春正月甲午朔，幸奉天宮，遣使祭嵩岳、少室、箕山、具茨等山，西王母、啟母、巢父、許由等祠。

translations.literal: First year of Hongdao, second year, spring, first month, on the jiawu new moon: he visited Fengtian Palace and sent envoys to sacrifice at Mount Song, Mount Shaoshi, Mount Ji, Mount Juci, and other mountains and at the shrines of the Queen Mother of the West, Qimu, Chao Fu, Xu You, and others.
translations.idiomatic: Hongdao 2, on the jiawu new moon of the first spring month: he went to Fengtian Palace and sent envoys to sacrifice at Mount Song, Shaoshi, Ji, Juci, and the shrines of the Queen Mother of the West, Qimu, Chao Fu, and Xu You.

sentences.zh: 二月甲午，洛州長史李仲玄為宗正卿。

translations.literal: Second month, jiawu: Luozhou Chief Secretary Li Zhongxuan became Director of the Imperial Clan.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu in the second month Luozhou chief secretary Li Zhongxuan became director of the imperial clan.

sentences.zh: 庚午，突厥寇定州、媯州之境。

translations.literal: On gengwu the Turks raided the borders of Ding and Ji prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu Turks raided Ding and Ji.

sentences.zh: 己卯，左領軍衛大將軍薛仁貴卒。

translations.literal: On jimao Grand General of the Left Victorious Army Xue Rengui died.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao left victor army grand general Xue Rengui died.

sentences.zh: 三月庚寅，突厥阿史那骨篤祿、阿史德元珍等圍單于都護府。

translations.literal: Third month, gengyin: Turks Gulolu and Ashide Yuanzhen besieged the Protectorate General of the Pacified North.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin in the third month Gulolu and Ashide Yuanzhen besieged the pacified north protectorate.

sentences.zh: 丙午，彗見五車北，二十五日而滅。

translations.literal: On bingwu a comet appeared north of the Wagon; after twenty-five days it vanished.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu a comet appeared north of the Wagon and faded after twenty-five days.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，中書令崔知溫卒。

translations.literal: On guichou Director of the Secretariat Cui Zhiwen died.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou secretariat director Cui Zhiwen died.

sentences.zh: 夏四月己巳，還東都。

translations.literal: Fourth month, summer, jisi: he returned to the eastern capital.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi in the fourth summer month he returned to the eastern capital.

sentences.zh: 甲申，綏州部落稽白鐵餘據城平縣反，命將軍程務挺將兵討之。

translations.literal: On jiashen the tribal chief Bai Tieyu of Sui held Chengping County in revolt; General Cheng Wuting was ordered to campaign against him.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen Sui tribal chief Bai Tieyu rebelled at Chengping; Cheng Wuting was sent against him.

sentences.zh: 五月庚寅，幸芳桂宮，陰雨，還東都。

translations.literal: Fifth month, gengyin: he visited Fragrant Cassia Palace; rain fell; he returned to the eastern capital.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin in the fifth month he went to Fragrant Cassia Palace, rain drove him back to the eastern capital.

sentences.zh: 突厥寇蔚州，殺刺史李思儉，豐州都督崔智辨率師出朝那山掩擊之，為賊所敗，遂寇嵐州。

translations.literal: The Turks raided Wei Prefecture and killed Prefect Li Sijian; Fengzhou Governor Cui Zhibian led troops out from Chaona Mountain to strike them and was defeated; they then raided Lan Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Turks raided Wei, killed prefect Li Sijian, beat Fengzhou governor Cui Zhibian at Chaona Mountain, then raided Lan.

sentences.zh: 秋七月已丑，封皇孫重福為唐昌郡王。

translations.literal: Seventh month, autumn, jichou: Imperial Grandson Chongfu was enfeoffed Prince of Tangchang.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou in the seventh autumn month imperial grandson Chongfu was made Prince of Tangchang.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，相王輪改封豫王，更名旦。

translations.literal: On jiachen Prince of Xiang Lun was changed to Prince of Yu and renamed Dan.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen Prince Xiang Lun became Prince Yu and took the name Dan.

sentences.zh: 己丑，令唐昌郡王重福為京留守，劉仁軌副之。

translations.literal: On jichou Prince of Tangchang Chongfu was made capital regent with Liu Ren'gui as deputy.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou Prince Tangchang Chongfu was made capital regent with Liu Ren'gui as deputy.

sentences.zh: 召皇太子至東都。

translations.literal: The crown prince was summoned to the eastern capital.
translations.idiomatic: The crown prince was called to the eastern capital.

sentences.zh: 己巳，河水溢，壞河陽城，水面高於城內五尺，北至鹽坎，居人廬舍漂沒皆盡，南北並壞。

translations.literal: On jisi the Yellow River overflowed and destroyed Heyang city; the water stood five chi higher than inside the walls; north to Yankan every dwelling was swept away; north and south banks were both wrecked.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi the Yellow River burst Heyang; water stood five chi above the streets; north to Yankan every house was swept away on both banks.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，熒惑入輿鬼，犯質星。

translations.literal: On gengxu Mars entered the Ghost Lodge and trespassed against Zhi.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu Mars entered the Ghost and struck Zhi.

sentences.zh: 十一月，皇太子來朝。

translations.literal: Eleventh month: the crown prince came to court.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month the crown prince arrived.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，幸奉天宮。

translations.literal: On guihai he visited Fengtian Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai he went to Fengtian Palace.

sentences.zh: 時天后自封岱之後，勸上封中嶽。

translations.literal: At this time, after the Heavenly Empress had herself performed fengshan at Mount Tai, she urged the emperor to perform fengshan at the Central Peak.
translations.idiomatic: By then the empress, having herself completed fengshan at Tai, pressed him to perform fengshan at the Central Peak.

sentences.zh: 每下詔草儀注，即歲饑、邊事警急而止。

translations.literal: Whenever edicts and ritual protocols were drafted, famine or border alarms halted the plan.
translations.idiomatic: Each time rites were drafted, famine or frontier crisis stopped them.

sentences.zh: 至是復行封中嶽禮，上疾而止。

translations.literal: Now the Central Peak rites were resumed, but the emperor's illness halted them.
translations.idiomatic: Now the central peak rites resumed, but his illness stopped them again.

sentences.zh: 上苦頭重不可忍，侍醫秦鳴鶴曰：「刺頭微出血，可愈。

translations.literal: The emperor suffered unbearable heaviness of the head; Attending Physician Qin Minghe said: "Pricking the head to draw a little blood may cure it."
translations.idiomatic: His head ached unbearably; physician Qin Minghe said: "A slight prick to draw blood may cure it."

sentences.zh: 」天後帷中言曰：「此可斬，欲刺血於人主首耶！

translations.literal: From behind the curtain the Heavenly Empress said: "This man should be executed—does he mean to draw blood from the sovereign's head?"
translations.idiomatic: From behind the curtain the empress said: "He should die—would he draw blood from the Son of Heaven's head?"

sentences.zh: 」上曰：「吾苦頭重，出血未必不佳。

translations.literal: The emperor said: "My head is heavy; bleeding may not be bad."
translations.idiomatic: The emperor said: "My head is heavy; blood may yet help."

sentences.zh: 」即刺百會，上曰：「吾眼明矣。

translations.literal: They pricked the Hundred Meetings point; the emperor said: "My eyes are clear."
translations.idiomatic: They pricked the Hundred Meetings; he said: "My eyes are clear."

sentences.zh: 」戊戌，命將軍程務挺為單于道安撫大使，以招討總管討山賊元珍、骨篤祿、賀魯等。

translations.literal: On wuxu General Cheng Wuting was made Pacification Commissioner of the Pacified North Circuit to campaign as supreme commander against the mountain bandits Yuanzhen, Gulolu, Helu, and others.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu Cheng Wuting became pacification commissioner on the pacified north circuit to crush Yuanzhen, Gulolu, Helu, and other bandits.

sentences.zh: 詔皇太子監國，裴炎、劉齊賢、郭正一等於東宮同平章事。

translations.literal: An edict ordered the crown prince to act as regent; Pei Yan, Liu Qixian, Guo Zhengyi, and others deliberated as chief ministers at the Eastern Palace.
translations.idiomatic: He put the crown prince in charge; Pei Yan, Liu Qixian, and Guo Zhengyi deliberated at the eastern palace.

sentences.zh: 丁未，自奉天宮還東都。

translations.literal: On dingwei he returned from Fengtian Palace to the eastern capital.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei he came back from Fengtian Palace to the eastern capital.

sentences.zh: 上疾甚，宰臣已下並不得謁見。

translations.literal: The emperor was gravely ill; chancellors and below were all denied audience.
translations.idiomatic: He was gravely ill; chancellors could not see him.

sentences.zh: 十二月己酉，詔改永淳二年為弘道元年。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, jiyou: an edict changed the second year of Yongchun to the first year of Hongdao.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou in the twelfth month Yongchun 2 became Hongdao 1.

sentences.zh: 將宣赦書，上欲親御則天門樓，氣逆不能上馬，遂召百姓於殿前宣之。

translations.literal: When the amnesty was to be proclaimed the emperor wished to ascend Zetian Gate himself but could not mount his horse for shortness of breath; he therefore summoned the people before the hall to proclaim it.
translations.idiomatic: To proclaim the amnesty he meant to mount Zetian Gate but could not breathe well enough to ride; the people were gathered before the hall instead.

sentences.zh: 禮畢，上問侍臣曰：「民庶喜否？

translations.literal: When the rite was done he asked his attendants: "Are the people pleased?"
translations.idiomatic: When it was done he asked: "Are the people glad?"

sentences.zh: 」曰：「百姓蒙赦，無不感悅。

translations.literal: They said: "The people receiving the pardon are all moved with joy."
translations.idiomatic: They answered: "Every man under the pardon rejoices."

sentences.zh: 」上曰：「蒼生雖喜，我命危篤。

translations.literal: The emperor said: "Though the common people rejoice, my life is in peril.
translations.idiomatic: He said: "The people may rejoice, but my life hangs by a thread.

sentences.zh: 天地神祇若延吾一兩月之命，得還長安，死亦無恨。

translations.literal: If Heaven and Earth and the spirits grant me another month or two to return to Chang'an, I shall die without regret."
translations.idiomatic: Grant me a month or two to reach Chang'an, and I will die content."

sentences.zh: 」是夕，帝崩於真觀殿，時年五十六。

translations.literal: That night the emperor died in Zhenguan Hall at the age of fifty-six.
translations.idiomatic: That night he died in Zhenguan Hall, aged fifty-six.

sentences.zh: 宣遺詔：「七日而殯，皇太子即位於柩前。

translations.literal: The testamentary edict was proclaimed: "Burial after seven days; the crown prince shall succeed before the coffin.
translations.idiomatic: The testament ran: "Bury after seven days; let the crown prince succeed before the coffin.

sentences.zh: 園陵制度，務從節儉。

translations.literal: Garden-tomb regulations must be thrifty.
translations.idiomatic: Keep the tomb plain.

sentences.zh: 軍國大事有不決者，取天后處分。

translations.literal: On military and state matters not decided, take the Heavenly Empress's ruling."
translations.idiomatic: What state and army cannot settle, let the empress decide."

sentences.zh: 」群臣上謚曰天皇大帝，廟號高宗。

translations.literal: The ministers offered the posthumous title Emperor of Heaven the Great; the temple name was Gaozong.
translations.idiomatic: The ministers gave the posthumous title Emperor of Heaven the Great and temple name Gaozong.

sentences.zh: 文明元年八月庚寅，葬於乾陵。

translations.literal: First year of Wenming, eighth month, gengyin: he was buried at Qianling.
translations.idiomatic: Wenming 1, on gengyin of the eighth month, he was buried at Qianling.

sentences.zh: 天寶十三載，改謚曰天皇大弘孝皇帝。

translations.literal: Thirteenth year of Tianbao: the posthumous title was changed to Emperor of Heaven the Greatly Broad and Filial.
translations.idiomatic: In Tianbao 13 the posthumous title became Emperor of Heaven the Greatly Broad and Filial.

sentences.zh: 【史評】史臣曰：大帝往在籓儲，見稱長者；

translations.literal: [Historian's appraisal] The historian says: When the Great Emperor was still heir in the fief, he was praised as a man of mature years;
translations.idiomatic: 【Historian's appraisal】 The historian writes: In the fief the heir was called a man of mature years;

sentences.zh: 暨升旒扆，頓異明哉。

translations.literal: once he ascended the imperial throne, he suddenly was not the same bright man.
translations.idiomatic: on the throne he was suddenly no longer that bright man.

sentences.zh: 虛襟似納於觸鱗，下詔無殊於扇暍。

translations.literal: An open breast seemed to take in remonstrance like fish-scales; his edicts were no different from fanning the heat.
translations.idiomatic: He seemed to welcome remonstrance, his edicts like cooling the fevered;

sentences.zh: 既蕩情於帷薄，遂忽怠於基扃。

translations.literal: once desire was loosed within the curtain, he soon neglected the foundation of rule.
translations.idiomatic: then desire behind the curtain made him neglect the state's base.

sentences.zh: 惑麥斛之佞言，中宮被毒；

translations.literal: Believing the flattery of wheat-measure, the empress was poisoned;
translations.idiomatic: He believed wheat-measure slander and the empress was poisoned;

sentences.zh: 聽趙師之誣說，元舅銜冤。

translations.literal: heeding the false tale of Zhao Shi, the empress's brother died with a grievance.
translations.idiomatic: he heard Zhao Shi's lies and the empress's brother died wronged.

sentences.zh: 忠良自是脅肩，奸佞於焉得志。

translations.literal: The loyal thereafter shrank their shoulders; villains thereby got their will.
translations.idiomatic: Loyal men shrank; villains had their way.

sentences.zh: 卒致盤維盡戮，宗社為墟。

translations.literal: In the end the imperial branches were slaughtered to the last and the altars became ruins.
translations.idiomatic: At last the imperial kin were slaughtered and the altars fell to ruin.

sentences.zh: 古所謂一國為一人興，前賢為後愚廢，信矣哉！

translations.literal: What the ancients called "one man raises a state, the wise of old ruined by the foolish after"—how true!
translations.idiomatic: So the ancients said one man can raise a state and the wise be undone by fools after—true indeed!

sentences.zh: 贊曰：藉文鴻業，僅保餘位。

translations.literal: [Eulogy] The eulogy says: Riding Wen's great enterprise, he barely kept the seat.
translations.idiomatic: 【Eulogy】 The eulogy says: He rode Wen's great work and barely kept the seat.

sentences.zh: 封岱禮天，其德不類。

translations.literal: Fengshan and worship of Heaven—his virtue did not match.
translations.idiomatic: He fengshan and worshipped Heaven, yet his virtue was not equal to the rite.

sentences.zh: 伏戎於寢，構堂終墜。

translations.literal: He housed arms in the bedchamber and built halls until they fell.
translations.idiomatic: He kept arms by the bed and built halls until they crashed down.

sentences.zh: 自蘊禍胎，邦家殄瘁。

translations.literal: From the womb of calamity the state was brought to ruin.
translations.idiomatic: From calamity's womb the state was ruined.
